headline: European leaders have welcomed the US-Iran ceasefire deal, calling for the reopening of the strait of Hormuz and a permanent end to hostilities. The US and Iran agreed a two-week conditional ceasefire after last-minute diplomacy from Pakistan.

Keeby adds real mechanical keyboard sounds to your MacBook. Every sound is recorded from actual switches, not synthesized. Choose from 11 switch profiles including Gateron Red, Holy Panda, Alps Blue, Box Navy, and more.

Researchers investigate the emergence of grounded compositional language in multi-agent populations, proposing a multi-agent learning environment and methods that bring about the emergence of a basic compositional language. The language is represented as streams of abstract discrete symbols uttered by agents over time, with a coherent structure that possesses a defined vocabulary and syntax.

Former Russian President Dmitry Medvedev argues that US President Donald Trump’s willingness to discuss a 10-point proposal on ending the war between Tehran and Washington is a “victory” for Iran. The announcement came after a temporary ceasefire between the US and Iran was announced by Trump.

A ceasefire has been announced, allowing Donald Trump to claim a victory, but Iran is now in a stronger position for peace talks. The Tehran regime has demonstrated its power and resilience, and will enter negotiations with the US in Pakistan on Friday.

Microsoft is working to migrate all old Control Panel items into the modern Settings app in Windows 11, but the process is complicated due to pesky printer and network drivers. The company has been trying to get rid of the Control Panel since 2012, but it's still not gone yet.

The Israeli army has issued an evacuation order for residents in southern Lebanon, citing planned military operations. Residents are urged to leave their homes and move north of the Zahrani River to ensure their safety.

Qarsoq Høegh-Dam, a member of the pro-independence Naleraq party, aims to shift power from Copenhagen to Nuuk. Greenland and Denmark have a complex history, with the island seeking greater autonomy and potentially independence.

A six-part Vietnam docuseries on Apple TV has received three nominations for the 47th Annual News & Documentary Emmy Awards. The series, titled 'Vietnam: The War That Changed America', is narrated by Ethan Hawke and showcases the reunion of old friends, first-person accounts, and rarely seen footage of the war.
The Israeli army said it is observing a ceasefire with Iran while remaining on high alert. The ceasefire announcement came after a joint offensive against Iran by the US and Israel.

Flint is a platform that helps teams scale on-brand landing pages. It launches fully coded, live on their domain, and shipped without engineering bottlenecks. Flint can be used to ship pages directly from tools like Claude, CRMs, and other GTM workflows.
OpenAI research on agents developing their own language. The agents learn words in combination with how they affect the world, rather than spotting patterns in a huge corpus of text.

US vice-president JD Vance continues his stay in Budapest, where he is expected to address the conservative Mathias Corvinus Collegium this morning on the back of his yesterday’s “not-at-all endorsement” of the embattled prime minister Viktor Orbán, five days out from the key election on Sunday. European leaders welcomed the news of a provisional ceasefire deal with Iran, but their relief may not last long as Nato’s Mark Rutte is travelling to Washington today to meet with Trump.

Türkiye welcomed the temporary ceasefire between the US and Iran, emphasizing that it must be fully implemented on the ground. The Turkish Foreign Ministry stated that a path to lasting peace can only be achieved through dialogue, diplomacy, and mutual trust.

The author suggests that Apple Arcade needs a separate 'always allow' feature from the App Store, allowing kids to download games without needing approval. The current Ask to Buy feature is useful but can be inconvenient for Apple Arcade games.
Orla Wates, 19, died after a motorcycle crash on the Ha Giang loop in Vietnam. Her family described her as 'beautiful, independent and very funny'.

Russia stated that the US' aggressive approach against Iran suffered a crushing defeat after a two-week ceasefire was announced. The ceasefire was agreed upon by US President Donald Trump and aims to stop the aggression against Iran.

Timeliner.io is an all-in-one workspace for content agencies and editors, replacing tools like Frame.io, ClickUp, and Google Drive. It offers features like project tracking, video review, client collaboration, and file organization.

OpenAI has created the world’s first Spam-detecting AI trained entirely in simulation and deployed on a physical robot. The AI is able to detect Spam in real images, even in the presence of never-before-seen “distractor” items arranged in random configurations.

Keir Starmer is travelling to the Gulf to meet leaders in the region to discuss diplomatic efforts to support the ceasefire agreed between the US and Iran. The prime minister’s visit comes hours after a two-week ceasefire was agreed, canceling a self-imposed deadline by the US president, Donald Trump, for Iran to surrender or face widespread destruction.

Two of the leading approaches for model-free reinforcement learning are policy gradient methods and Q-learning methods. Q-learning methods can be effective and sample-efficient when they work, however, it is not well-understood why they work.

Israeli opposition leader Yair Lapid criticized Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu for backing a temporary ceasefire between the US and Iran. Lapid called it a 'political and strategic failure' and said Israel was not present when decisions were made about its national security.

watchOS 26.4 addresses a major complaint about the new Workout app design, making it easier to start a workout with a single tap. The update improves the user experience by allowing users to start a workout directly from the workout type icon.

The US and Iran have agreed to a two-week ceasefire, barely an hour before Donald Trump’s Wednesday deadline to obliterate the country and its infrastructure. Iran’s Supreme National Security Council said it had conditionally accepted the two-week ceasefire if attacks against Iran are halted.

Google has released an offline-first dictation app called Google AI Edge Eloquent on iOS, which uses Gemma AI models to transcribe speech and edit out filler words. The app is free to download and can be used offline after the initial download of the ASR models.

Energy prices saw sharp declines following the ceasefire decision between Iran and the US on Wednesday. Brent futures decreased by around 15% to $92.9 while West Texas Intermediate (WTI) was at $94.8, down 16%.
Access to the website has been blocked due to a security measure. The block was triggered by a specific action that resembled an online attack.

FlowPulse is a tool that helps users track and monitor their automations, providing a single place to see history, reports, and alerts. It supports n8n, Make, Zapier, and custom stacks, and offers features such as run ledger, alert rules, and 'go quiet' detection.

Turkey has given the green light to more batteries to buffer its electricity grid than any EU member state, with over 33GW of battery capacity approved since 2022. The country is targeting 120GW of installed wind and solar capacity by 2035.

Roboschool is open-source software for robot simulation, integrated with OpenAI Gym, providing new environments for controlling robots in simulation. It removes the constraint of requiring a paid MuJoCo license, letting everyone conduct research regardless of their budget.

OpenAI is open-sourcing its internal effort to reproduce reinforcement learning algorithms, starting with DQN and its variants. The goal is to ensure that apparent RL advances are not due to comparison with buggy or untuned versions of existing algorithms.

Israel supports US President Donald Trump’s decision to suspend military strikes against Iran for two weeks. The ceasefire does not include Lebanon, according to Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu's office.

Matt Canavan's economic plan is criticized as a populist mirage that would lead to increased government debt and more expensive goods for Australians. The plan includes scrapping net zero, digging up more oil and coal, and slashing migration.
The wired Google Nest Doorbell is on sale for $140, a $40 discount from its usual price. This video doorbell has a 166-degree field of view and can be integrated with other Google devices.

The US congratulated Communist Party General Secretary To Lam on his election as Vietnam’s president and Le Minh Hung on his election as prime minister. The State Department highlighted the value of its Comprehensive Strategic Partnership with Vietnam.

Anthropic has announced a new initiative called Project Glasswing to help address concerns about the potential negative impacts of artificial intelligence, particularly in cybersecurity. The endeavor includes major tech companies as partners, who will use an unreleased model from Anthropic to enhance their security projects.

Democrats welcome the truce and call for accountability, as Republican hawks voice scepticism about talks with Tehran. The two-week truce will see Iran reopen the Strait of Hormuz as Tehran and Washington negotiate a lasting end to the war.

Flight Viz is a 3D flight tracker that allows users to watch 10K+ live flights move on a globe in their browser. The tool provides live data, weather radar, and altitude profiles, and is built with Rust compiled to WebAssembly and raw WebGL2 shaders.
OpenAI developed an algorithm that can infer what humans want by being told which of two proposed behaviors is better. The algorithm can learn from human feedback to solve modern RL environments.

The US will help with the traffic buildup in the Strait of Hormuz, President Donald Trump said, following a two-week ceasefire with Iran. Trump announced the suspension of bombing and attack on Iran for a period of two weeks.

Australian minister for energy and climate change, Chris Bowen, says fuel prices will come down when the US war on Iran ends, but warns that the current ceasefire will not immediately lead to cheaper fuel.
A former AirPods engineer is now working on heat pumps, aiming to make them cheaper and easier to install. Merino Energy has simplified the heat pump design, reducing installation time and cost.

UN Secretary-General Antonio Guterres welcomed the announcement of a two-week ceasefire by the US and Iran. Guterres calls on all parties to comply with their obligations under international law and to abide by the terms of the ceasefire.

Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu’s office has announced that Israel backs the United States’s decision to suspend strikes against Iran for two weeks, but said the truce will not apply to Lebanon. The two-week ceasefire was announced after Pakistani Prime Minister Shehbaz Sharif said the US, Iran and their allies ‘have agreed to an immediate ceasefire everywhere including Lebanon and elsewhere’.

US political leaders react to Trump's announcement of a provisional ceasefire with Iran, with some calling it a 'strong first step' and others criticizing his 'ridiculous bluster'. The agreement was mediated by Pakistan and will allow for the reopening of the Strait of Hormuz for two weeks.

Iran-linked hackers have targeted US energy and water infrastructure, causing disruptions and financial losses. The hackers have compromised industrial control systems, including those used in water and wastewater utilities.

CrewCue is a digital scheduling tool for event crews, providing live schedules on the Lock Screen for easy access and real-time updates. It aims to replace traditional printed day sheets and WhatsApp chaos with a streamlined and organized solution.

The Trump administration is planning to cut the budget of the U.S. Cybersecurity and Infrastructure Security Agency (CISA) by at least $707 million for 2027. The proposed budget cut was released late last week as part of an omnibus budget proposal that includes the privatization of airport security.

A US lawmaker has filed articles of impeachment against President Donald Trump, citing concerns over his conduct and handling of the war with Iran. The move comes as Trump announced a two-week suspension of military action against Iran.

OpenAI is open-sourcing a high-performance Python library for robotic simulation using the MuJoCo engine. The library, called mujoco-py, brings a number of new capabilities and significant performance boosts.

Gina Rinehart questions the justification for the years-long investigation into alleged war crimes committed by Australian soldiers in Afghanistan and the arrest of Ben Roberts-Smith. Pockets of support emerge for the Victoria Cross recipient.

The Teacher–student curriculum learning framework is proposed for automatic curriculum learning. The Student tries to learn a complex task and the Teacher automatically chooses subtasks from a given set for the Student to train on.

Researchers have created images that reliably fool neural network classifiers when viewed from varied scales and perspectives. This challenges a claim that self-driving cars would be hard to trick maliciously since they capture images from multiple scales, angles, and perspectives.

New Zealand Foreign Minister Winston Peters welcomed a two-week ceasefire deal between the US and Iran, emphasizing that significant work remains to secure a durable resolution. The ceasefire was brokered with the help of Pakistan and other regional partners, including Türkiye and Egypt.

Elon Musk is taking OpenAI to court over its transition to a for-profit company and wants any damages awarded to the OpenAI nonprofit branch. He's also seeking OpenAI CEO Sam Altman's removal from the nonprofit's board of directors.
Tropical Cyclone Vaianu is moving south of Fiji towards New Zealand, with winds at centre in excess of 150km/h. Forecasters have warned of life-threatening winds and heavy rain for the North Island.

WhatsApp has released its improved CarPlay experience to all iPhone users, featuring a new contact info interface, call history, and support for favorite contacts. The update builds on recent CarPlay improvements from other apps like ChatGPT and Google Meet.
Iran will stop operations if attacks cease, Abbas Araghchi says, outlining Hormuz passage plan. Iran has put forward a 10-point proposal for ending the war.

Russian satellites made detailed imagery of military facilities and critical sites across the Middle East, which were then attacked by Iran. Ukraine claims Russian satellites flew over before and after the attacks to assess damage.

Laminar is a native planetary imaging capture app for macOS and Apple Silicon, allowing users to record high-framerate SER video of celestial bodies with real-time frame quality analysis and automatic target tracking. The app is free to download with an optional one-time Pro upgrade.

Uber is expanding its AWS contract to run more of its ride-sharing features on Amazon's chips, a deal that is seen as a thumb in the nose to Oracle and Google. The company will use AWS's Graviton and start a new trial testing Trainium3, AWS's Nvidia competitor AI chip.

OpenAI releases RL-Teacher, an open-source implementation of their interface to train AIs via human feedback. The system consists of a reward predictor, an example agent, and a web-app for humans to give feedback.

US Secretary of State Marco Rubio announced the release of American journalist Shelly Kittleson, who was kidnapped in Iraq. Kittleson was kidnapped in Baghdad on March 31 and her capture came amid regional escalations since Israel and the US launched an offensive against Iran on Feb. 28.

We’ve created a bot which beats the world’s top professionals at 1v1 matches of Dota 2 under standard tournament rules. The bot learned the game from scratch by self-play, and does not use imitation learning or tree search.
Australian federal police arrested Ben Roberts-Smith at Sydney airport on Tuesday over alleged war crimes. He did not apply for bail on Wednesday after spending the night in jail.

The Albanese government’s plans to restrict gambling advertising will reduce Australia’s annual gambling spending by $62.7m a year, according to a government report. A full ban on gambling ads would have a higher net benefit but would impose a significant financial burden on the industry.
Intel will join SpaceX and Tesla in an effort to build a new U.S. semiconductor factory in Texas. The scope of its contributions are unclear.

Italy warns Iranian civilians must not pay price for 'rulers' wrongdoings' amid escalation fears. The Italian government said it is continuing to follow very closely developments in the Middle East crisis and the risk of further military escalation.

Former UN climate chief Christiana Figueres warns that countries are being held hostage by their reliance on fossil fuels, describing the health impacts of climate change as the mother of all injustices. A new Lancet Commission will examine how sea-level rise is reshaping health, wellbeing and inequality.

Firmus, an Asia AI data center provider, has raised $505 million at a $5.5 billion post-money valuation. The company is developing an energy-efficient “AI factory” network of data centers in Australia and Tasmania.
Netflix is a streaming service that offers a wide variety of award-winning TV shows, movies, anime, documentaries, and more. It has launched a new standalone kids games app called Netflix Playground.

Turkish Foreign Minister Hakan Fidan and his Pakistani counterpart Muhammad Ishaq Dar discussed the Iran war in a phone call. The two ministers exchanged views on diplomatic efforts to bring an end to the war.

Iranian musician Ali Ghamsari has been performing outside the Damavand power station in a symbolic protest against US threats against civilian infrastructure. The site supplies roughly half of Tehran’s electricity.

The US government intends to deport Kilmar Ábrego García to Liberia, despite a new agreement with Costa Rica to accept deportees. García, a Salvadorian national, has been fighting deportation after being mistakenly sent to El Salvador last year.

The budget-friendly earbuds offer a transparency mode, an adjustable EQ, and plenty of other premium features. Nothing’s noise-canceling CMF Buds 2A are available on Amazon for $19.99, which matches their lowest price to date.
Eclipse, a Palo Alto-based VC, has announced a new $1.3 billion fund to invest in 'physical AI' startups, with a focus on transportation, energy, infrastructure, and more.
The US and Israel attacked Iran's largest aluminum producer and a petrochemical facility. No casualties were reported in the strike on the Amirkabir complex in Khuzestan.

Arsenal score late winner at Sporting Lisbon to take 1-0 first-leg advantage back to London next week. Arsenal will be firm favourites to advance to the semi-finals in the second leg in north London on April 15, but they will have to improve significantly to win the tournament for the first time.

Iranians are preparing for potential US airstrikes as Donald Trump's deadline for Iran to open the strait of Hormuz approaches. The Iranian government has called on young people to form human chains around power plants, and people in Tehran are stocking up on basic provisions.

Amazon has announced that it will end support for older Kindle and Kindle Fire devices, affecting models released in 2012 and earlier. The devices will no longer be able to access the Kindle Store after May 20th, 2026.

Arcee, a tiny 26-person U.S. startup, built a high-performing, massive, open source LLM on a $20 million shoestring budget. The company has released its new reasoning model, Trinity Large Thinking, which is comparable to some of the other top open source models.

Gauge is a marketing agent for organic, paid, and AI search, providing visibility into ads in ChatGPT and managing ChatGPT ad campaigns. It unifies data sources into a single agent that can do the work of an entire marketing team.

US President Donald Trump condemned Iran’s mobilization of civilians to form human chains around key power plants, calling the tactic “totally illegal.” Iranians encircled power facilities after Trump warned civilization would die without a deal.

Researchers at OpenAI have found that self-play allows simulated AIs to discover physical skills like tackling and kicking without explicit design. Self-play ensures the environment is always the right difficulty for an AI to improve.
Australian Prime Minister Anthony Albanese discusses energy security with Chinese Premier Li Qiang, while Ben Roberts-Smith is set to appear in court on war crime charges.
Bluesky users blame service disruptions on 'vibe coding' despite lack of evidence. The use of AI coding tools has become a convenient boogeyman for any tech issues.

MIT.nano's START.nano program has announced 16 new startups, more than doubling the number of new companies from the previous year. The program supports new ventures through discounted use of MIT.nano shared facilities and guided access to the MIT innovation ecosystem.

US-Israeli strikes flattened Rafieinia Synagogue in Tehran, Iran says, describing the attack as a 'despicable crime'. The attack is 'abhorred by all Iranians', according to Foreign Ministry spokesman Esmaeil Baqaei.

Politicians warn party’s pledge to ‘punish’ countries seeking justice for slavery will harm and isolate Britain. Commonwealth leaders say they will not back down from seeking reparations as UK public figures warn the rightwing party’s pledge would harm and isolate Britain.

A new profile of Sam Altman, CEO of OpenAI, raises questions about the future of AI and the personalities running key Silicon Valley companies. The article reveals a lack of nuance and a will to power among tech leaders.

Spotify has expanded its Prompted Playlists feature to include podcasts, allowing Premium users to create custom Discover Weekly playlists for podcast episodes. The feature uses natural language text prompts to generate playlists based on specific genres or themes.
OpenBrowser-AI connects AI agents to browsers through raw CDP, achieving 100% accuracy and 59% lower inference costs. It allows for browser automation with a persistent namespace and code batching.
Romanian football coach Mircea Lucescu has died at age 80. The Romanian Football Federation announced his passing and paid tribute to him as an 'absolute legend' who shaped generations of football.
US journalist Shelly Kittleson was kidnapped in Baghdad and held by an Iran-backed militia. She has been released and must leave the country immediately.

Iranian hackers have escalated their tactics by targeting American critical infrastructure systems, aiming to cause disruption. A joint advisory by the FBI, NSA, and CISA warns of the increased threat, which includes targeting water and waste-water utilities, energy, and local government facilities.

Researchers at OpenAI have developed a meta-learning agent that can learn to quickly defeat a stronger non-meta-learning agent in simulated robot wrestling, and also adapt to physical malfunction. The agent uses a modified version of the Model-Agnostic Meta-Learning (MAML) algorithm.

The Selfix phone case is a classic example of a great idea in theory that falls apart in practice. It’s a case for the iPhone 17 Pro with a circular screen on the back, but it doesn't do its main job very well.
Kuwait's Interior Ministry has urged citizens to stay home between 12 am and 6 am local time as a precautionary measure amid escalation in the ongoing war between Iran, the US and Israel.
US vice-president JD Vance visits Hungary to support Viktor Orbán in the country's election campaign, but polls suggest Orbán may still lose his 16-year grip on power.

Android XR is getting a new feature that turns 2D apps, websites, images, and videos into 3D experiences. The feature, which Google calls auto-spatialization, is launching on Tuesday as an experimental feature for Samsung Galaxy XR headsets. This feature could be an interesting new way to get a more immersive view of things you’re looking at in your headset.

AppSignals is a business intelligence software that helps app founders understand their subscription revenue using data from App Store Connect. It provides key metrics such as install → trial → paid conversion rates, revenue per install, and revenue trends. The software is designed to help founders make better acquisition decisions and optimize their app's performance.

Russia vetoed a Bahraini-led UN Security Council draft resolution on the Strait of Hormuz, saying it grants 'carte blanche for the continued aggressive acts and ongoing further escalation' against Iran. Russia and China are preparing an alternative draft resolution.

US vice-president JD Vance has accused the EU of interfering in Hungary's upcoming elections, as he visited the country to support Viktor Orbán's re-election bid. Vance's comments were made during a press conference in Budapest, where he also praised Orbán as a 'great example' of a leader who has maintained his country's energy independence.

Anthropic is debuting a new AI model as part of a cybersecurity partnership with Nvidia, Google, Amazon Web Services, Apple, Microsoft, and other companies. Project Glasswing, as it’s called, is billed as a way for large companies, and potentially even the government, to flag vulnerabilities in their systems with virtually no human intervention.

The one piece of data that could shed light on your job and AI. Plus: Trump wants to slash science and tech spending again. Data centers in space could unleash the potential of AI without triggering an environmental crisis on Earth.

Turkish Foreign Minister Hakan Fidan and UK Foreign Secretary Yvette Cooper discussed diplomatic efforts to end the war in the region and establish a sustainable peace. They also reviewed bilateral relations between Türkiye and the UK.

The United Kingdom has blocked US rapper Kanye West from entering the country due to his anti-Semitic comments and celebrations of Nazism. West was booked to headline a summer festival in London, but the event has been cancelled.

A woman gave birth on a Caribbean Airlines flight from Jamaica to New York, prompting questions about the baby's citizenship. The baby was born during the four-hour flight, and the mother and child are receiving medical care.
The whole S26 lineup is discounted, and the feature-packed S26 Ultra is now just $100 more than the S26 Plus. The S26 Ultra has a 6.9-inch 3120 x 1440 OLED screen and supports an S Pen stylus.

Estonian Foreign Minister Margus Tsahkna emphasizes the importance of keeping Ukraine as a priority amid the US-Israeli war with Iran. He also discusses NATO's role and the potential consequences of the Middle East conflict on European security.

European stocks closed sharply lower Tuesday as investors returned from the Easter break to mounting geopolitical anxiety after US President Donald Trump escalated his threats against Iran. The pan-European Stoxx Europe 600 index fell 1.01% to finish at 590.59 points.

Ben Roberts-Smith, a former Australian soldier, is facing five counts of war crime - murder, each carrying a potential life sentence. The case against him alleges he murdered unarmed civilians while serving in Afghanistan.
Chrome just shipped a better browser layout, and almost everyone will benefit from using it. Vertical tabs are hardly a new idea about browsers, but Chrome has executed the idea pretty well.

Google Chrome's latest update brings vertical tabs and a cleaner Reading Mode to help manage cluttered browsing. The new feature allows users to move tabs to the side of the browser window, making it easier to read full page titles and manage tab groups.

A dam burst in Russia's southern region of Daghestan has caused flooding, resulting in the evacuation of over 4,000 people and at least four deaths. The flooding was caused by record rainfall and melting mountain snow.

Iran has not conveyed any message regarding the reported closure of indirect talks with the US, according to a Pakistani government official. The talks were facilitated by Islamabad after US President Donald Trump threatened to destroy Iran's 'whole civilization'.

A First Nation in Alberta has asked a court to halt a separatist push for the province to secede from Canada, arguing it would violate their treaty rights. The Sturgeon Lake Cree Nation has filed a court challenge to stop the referendum, which is scheduled to take place in October.

Russian government hackers have hijacked thousands of home and small business routers around the world to steal passwords and access tokens. The hacking group, known as Fancy Bear, targeted unpatched routers made by MicroTik and TP-Link using previously disclosed vulnerabilities.

The Bose Soundlink Flex is on sale for $119, and you can also save on Google's third-gen Nest Doorbell and an integrated 30W charger. The second-gen Flex features a redesigned control strip and support for higher-res AAC and aptX codecs.

Deep learning-based robotic grasping has made significant progress, but generalization can be a challenge. This work explores a novel data generation pipeline for training a deep neural network to perform grasp planning.

NASA's Artemis II mission has sent back high-resolution images of the Moon, including a stunning view of the Earth rising behind the Moon. The images were captured by the crew during their flyby of the Moon.

Pakistan's Foreign Minister Ishaq Dar blamed Israel for trying to spoil Islamabad's efforts to facilitate ceasefire talks between the US and Iran. The talks were at a stage where both sides were set to sit down when Israel attacked Iran.

A Cambodian man deported by the US to Eswatini has spoken out about his experience, saying he would have accepted being sent to Cambodia but was instead imprisoned in a foreign country. Pheap Rom was one of 15 people sent to prison in Eswatini last year despite completing US sentences.

Anthropic has signed a new agreement with Google and Broadcom for increased processing and compute capacity to power its Claude AI models. The company has seen demand for its AI models explode in recent months, with its run-rate revenue surging to $30 billion.

Suno is struggling to reach licensing deals with Universal Music Group and Sony Music Entertainment over AI-generated music sharing. The two sides can't agree on whether users should be able to share the AI-generated songs they create.
VoxTori is a native Mac app for live subtitles, real-time translation, and dictation. It works across meetings, videos, and podcasts, and stays private on-device by default.

Canada's prime minister calls on all parties in the Mideast conflict to respect international law and avoid targeting civilians or civilian infrastructure. The US president has set a deadline for Iran, fueling speculation about potential action.

The Greens’ Max Chandler-Mather says the major parties are ‘completely disconnected from ordinary people’s lives’. He plans to organise thousands of volunteers to conduct a major survey of economic and social life around Australia.

Conflict and extreme weather could threaten large desalination plants that supply water to the region. Desalination technology has helped provide water supplies in the Middle East since the early 20th century and became widespread in the 1960s and 1970s.

Intel will help design and build a semiconductor factory for SpaceX and Tesla to supply AI chips. The factory is a crucial part of Elon Musk’s plans to build a “robot army” that includes self-driving cars and humanoid robots.
Google is rolling out new features to make it easier for users to contribute local knowledge to Maps. Gemini can now create captions when users are looking to share a photo or video about a place.

The Netherlands has signed a deal to buy a new Patriot air defense system worth $1.1 billion. The new Patriot is expected to be delivered in a few years, bringing the total number of the country's Patriot defense systems to 5.

An RMIT University student faces potential suspension over a video accusing the institution of being complicit in genocide due to its defence and aerospace research centre’s ties to weapons companies. The student, Gemma Seymour, is due to face a student conduct hearing on 22 April regarding the allegations of misconduct.

Apple has announced that its multiversal thriller Dark Matter is coming back for its second season, which will start streaming on August 28th. The new season will span 10 episodes and wrap up in October.
Rivian's new R2 SUV is expected to launch with an EPA range estimate of 335 miles, according to leaked documents. The range estimate is based on the vehicle's performance with 21-inch wheels.

Gaia is an AI architectural rendering and interior design tool that allows users to create photorealistic renders in seconds. It has 144+ industry-grade templates and presets, and remembers the user's design sensibility to improve future renders.

India's most advanced nuclear reactor has reached a self-sustaining stage, marking a major leap for the country's atomic energy programme. The prototype fast breeder reactor at Kalpakkam in the southern Indian state of Tamil Nadu reached criticality, bringing India closer to cutting its dependence on uranium and using thorium instead.

President Recep Tayyip Erdogan says Türkiye targets $11B in defense and aerospace exports in 2028. The country aims to produce high-tech products more quickly and effectively to become one of the world's top 10 defense exporters.

The #MeToo movement has sparked a wave of harassment claims in Colombia, with dozens of female journalists coming forward to share their experiences. The movement has also led to the termination of contracts of two high-profile journalists and sparked a national conversation about sexual harassment.

AI agents are beginning to define how organizations operate and compete. Companies must become agent-first, redesigning processes around agents rather than bolting them onto fragmented legacy workflows.

The Zenbook A16 is a large laptop that weighs very little and performs great. It is a unique Windows laptop for anyone seeking the most screen real estate in one of the lightest and most capable packages, and a worthwhile alternative to a 15-inch MacBook Air.

The European Union is considering energy-saving measures due to the impact of the US-Israel-led war with Iran on energy prices and supplies. EU groups will meet to discuss measures such as reduced air travel and work-from-home directives.
The concept of free will is explored in a 48-minute video discussion. The debate delves into the idea of whether humans can truly shape their own destiny.

Russia's international reserves have declined by 7.45% in March to $749 billion, according to the Russian central bank. The decline is attributed to Western countries freezing access to roughly half of the Russian central bank's reserves following the war in Ukraine.

A row has broken out in one of Canada’s wealthiest neighbourhoods over plans to use an AI-powered surveillance system to create the country’s first “virtual gated community” to combat surging property crime. Residents of Rosedale have been left on edge by a sustained rise in home invasions, with robbers targeting the tree-lined neighbourhood at a rate more than double the city average.
The Artemis II astronauts have captured a stunning photo of a total solar eclipse from space. The image shows the Moon as a black orb surrounded by the sun's halo.

Marmot is an open-source data catalog designed for teams who want powerful data discovery without enterprise complexity. It provides a single source of truth for data and gives AI agents context around the data.

The US Immigration and Customs Enforcement agency says its personnel do not make arrests or carry guns while operating in Canada. The announcement comes ahead of the FIFA World Cup, which will be co-hosted by the US and Canada.

Russian Foreign Minister Sergey Lavrov discussed the US-Israeli-Iranian conflict with his UAE counterpart. The diplomats highlighted the importance of an immediate cessation of hostilities in the Persian Gulf region.

JP Morgan Chase has reached agreement with London City airport to build one of Europe’s tallest office towers in the east of the capital. The £3bn tower is poised to be the tallest in the Canary Wharf financial district.
DJI is banned in the United States and nobody is coming to save you. The US drone market is shifting towards defense and military applications, leaving consumer drones behind.

Former Australian cricketer David Warner has been charged with drink-driving after being pulled over in Sydney. The 39-year-old, who retired from international cricket in 2024, still plays Twenty20 cricket for franchises around the world.

A container vessel was struck by an unidentified projectile about 25 nautical miles south of Iran’s Kish Island. The incident has caused damage above the waterline, but no environmental damage has been reported.

The UK government has banned Kanye West from entering the country due to his previous antisemitic statements. West, who is legally known as Ye, had been booked to perform at the Wireless festival in London in July.

AIDesigner is a tool that turns simple prompts into beautiful, original UI designs without the "vibe-coded" look. It creates landing pages, dashboards, mobile screens, and components in seconds and allows for direct editing and refinement. The AI Designer MCP gives coding agents access to design tools and skills to generate beautiful, relevant UI and incorporate it directly into the codebase.

Kanye West faces backlash over planned appearance at London's Wireless festival, with Jewish groups calling for him to cancel his shows. West has offered to meet with Jewish community leaders to discuss his past antisemitic remarks.

Hermeus, a defense aviation startup, has raised $350 million to develop autonomous hypersonic fighters. The company has had two successful test flights and is aiming to make its next aircraft go supersonic.
We tested the best electric bikes in every category, from commuters and mountain bikes to foldables and cruisers.

Pakistan and China have released a joint five-part proposal for peace in the Middle East, after Pakistan’s foreign minister flew to Beijing to seek Chinese support for the country’s faltering efforts to negotiate an end to the war. The proposal calls for an immediate ceasefire and the protection of waterways, including the blockaded strait of Hormuz.

Nominations for Startup Battlefield 200 are open, and the strongest contenders are already stepping forward. Selected 200 have a chance at VC access, TechCrunch coverage, and $100K for Startup Battlefield 200. Applications close on May 27.

A criminal complaint accusing Myanmar's newly-elected president Min Aung Hlaing of genocide has been filed by a group of civil society organizations in Indonesia. The move was made under Indonesia’s new penal law, which allows for universal jurisdiction in cases involving serious international crimes, including genocide.

Mediators want both sides to agree to suspend hostilities but Tehran warns peace talks ‘incompatible with threats’. Proposals for an immediate ceasefire have been circulated to Washington and Tehran in an attempt to halt the five-week-old war.

Gemini 2.0 Flash offers stronger performance and simplified pricing, making it more affordable for developers to build applications. Gemini 2.0 Flash-Lite is now generally available for production use in Google AI Studio and for enterprise customers on Vertex AI.

Bryan Fleming, the founder of pcTattletale, has avoided jail time after pleading guilty to U.S. federal charges associated with running his surveillance company. He was sentenced to time served and a $5,000 fine. Fleming's criminal conviction marks the first successful prosecution of a spyware maker by the U.S. Department of Justice since 2014.

This article discusses a general learning framework for modeling agent behavior in multiagent systems. The framework casts agent modeling as a representation learning problem and demonstrates its utility in various environments.

Hungarian Prime Minister Viktor Orban visited the TurkStream gas pipeline on the Hungarian-Serbian border after Serbian authorities announced the discovery of explosives near the conduit. Serbia's military intelligence pushed back on claims blaming Ukraine for the incident.
The first run of our Retro Contest is complete, with Dharmaraja topping the scoreboard. The contest explored the development of algorithms that can generalize from previous experience.

Tougher ethical certification process requires companies to meet standards in every one out of seven categories. Dozens of companies may be at risk of losing their coveted B Corp ethical status after the organisation behind the corporate kite-marking system raised the standards required to qualify.

OpenAI proposes public wealth fund, tax overhaul, 4-day workweek, and grid expansion to address risks of job losses and rising energy demand from AI systems. The company aims to navigate the transition to superintelligence through a democratic process.

Epismo is a platform to share and manage powerful human-AI workflows. It allows users to design tasks and steps, route each step to the best agent, and enforce quality with explicit checks. Epismo also enables users to clone proven workflows from the community, customize them to their needs, and publish their own for others to reuse.

German mayors have called for a nationwide ban on night-time use of robot lawnmowers to protect hedgehogs and other small nocturnal animals from being killed or maimed in the dark. The mayors say automated mowers’ blades threaten nocturnal animals as studies highlight risks to wildlife.

Turkish Foreign Minister Hakan Fidan received US Ambassador to Ankara and Special Envoy for Syria Tom Barrack in the Turkish capital. Fidan and Barrack held a meeting in Ankara, sources from the Turkish Foreign Ministry said, without providing further details.
Gemma 3 is a collection of lightweight, state-of-the-art open models designed to run on devices. It outperforms other models in its size class and supports over 140 languages.

Artificial intelligence tools like Alibaba's Accio are helping small entrepreneurs in the US decide what products to sell and where to make them, making the process faster and more accessible. Accio has gained significant momentum, with over 10 million monthly active users, and is changing the way small online sellers do business.

Thailand's prime minister, Anutin Charnvirakul, has called on the public to conserve energy, urging work-from-home measures and carpooling, as he warned of the impact of the conflict in the Middle East.

Former British Defense Secretary Ben Wallace warned that the UK is currently unable to defend against long-range Iranian missiles. He accused government ministers of downplaying the threat amid the ongoing conflict between Iran, the US, and Israel.

Ogoron is an AI-powered QA tool that acts as a full QA team, understanding your product, generating and maintaining tests, and validating every change. It helps you ship faster, stay in control, and break nothing.

Thousands of independent businesses across the UK are braced for their energy bills to more than double owing to the sharp rise in heating oil costs as the war in Iran pushed Europe’s fuel market prices to fresh record highs. About 7% of all small and medium-sized companies warm their properties and provide hot water using heating oil, which in some cases has more than doubled in recent weeks.
OpenAI Five, a team of five neural networks, has started to defeat amateur human teams at Dota 2. The team aims to beat a team of top professionals at The International in August.

European Council President Antonio Costa stated that escalation in Iran will not bring a ceasefire or peace. Costa emphasized the need for negotiations to continue, saying that only a diplomatic solution can settle the root causes of the war in the Middle East.

Researchers have trained an agent to achieve a high score of 74,500 on Montezuma’s Revenge from a single human demonstration. The algorithm is simple and works by letting each RL episode start from a state in a previously recorded demonstration.

The new VR game Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles: Empire City will be released on April 30 for the Meta Quest, Steam VR and Pico. It is made by VR game company Cortopia Studios and will retail for $25. Empire City is a first-person action game that you’ll be able to play solo or co-op with up to four people.

The SEO industry is trying to influence AI responses, with some firms claiming they can get chatbots to mention their brand. However, experts say this is not a reliable strategy and may not be effective in the long run.

The Israeli prime minister's promise of a quick and easy war with Iran has been called into question as the conflict enters its second month with no end in sight. Donald Trump's involvement in the war has also been scrutinized, with some officials suggesting he was misled by Netanyahu's promises.

Gemini 2.0 Flash is now available for developer experimentation across all regions supported by Google AI Studio. This new capability allows for native image output and can be tested using an experimental version of Gemini 2.0 Flash in Google AI Studio and via the Gemini API.

B150 is a new professional network for Gen AI builders. The platform allows creators to build the future together, code apps and websites, create art, make music, build games, automate marketing, or generate films.

A historically warm winter across nine states in the US has left the mountain snowpack at critically low levels, raising concerns about a potentially severe wildfire season. Tropical Cyclone Maila has developed in the Solomon Sea and is expected to strengthen to severe tropical cyclone status.
NASA astronauts on the Artemis mission are taking stunning shots of Earth using iPhone 17 Pro Max. The images show Earth through the window of the Orion spaceship's capsule.

OpenAI is offering a slate of people-first policy ideas designed to expand opportunity, share prosperity, and build resilient institutions. These ideas are ambitious, but intentionally early and exploratory.

The App Store saw a huge jump in new apps this past year, with 235,800 new apps in the first three months of 2026, up 84% from the same time period last year. This surge is attributed to the rise of vibe coding, which allows users to create apps without coding experience.
A 16-year-old surfer was bitten by a shark while surfing in South Australia. The teenager described how he managed to escape the shark and make it back to shore.

France's foreign minister warned Iran that targeting infrastructure would further escalate tensions, as both sides exchanged messages during a phone call. Iran's Foreign Minister Abbas Araghchi said US threats to attack Iranian infrastructure amount to a 'normalization of war crimes and genocide.'
Moonshot is a macOS menu bar app that tracks NASA's Artemis II mission in real time. It shows mission phases, countdowns to key events, and live telemetry context.

Artificial intelligence has long been a cornerstone of cybersecurity, but as we move closer to artificial general intelligence, AI's potential to automate defenses and fix vulnerabilities becomes even more powerful. A new framework for evaluating the emerging offensive cyber capabilities of AI helps identify which defenses are necessary and how to prioritize them.

Two exhibitions at the British Film Institute and the National Portrait Gallery will mark the centenary of Marilyn Monroe's birth, celebrating her as a performer of sharp comic intelligence and a canny architect of her own image.

Four people were killed after a vehicle being pursued by police went off the road and struck a tree in Alabama. The incident occurred late Friday on a rural road in Pike County as the driver attempted to flee from law enforcement officers.
We introduce Glow, a reversible generative model which uses invertible 1x1 convolutions. Glow extends previous work on reversible generative models and simplifies the architecture.

Sony Interactive Entertainment has acquired Cinemersive Labs, a UK startup that develops tools to convert 2D photos and videos into 3D volumes. The startup team will join Sony's Visual Computing Group.

Two research teams have discovered thousands of antiviral defence proteins in bacteria, which could inspire new biotechnologies. The proteins were identified using machine-learning algorithms that screened bacterial genomes.

Severe Tropical Cyclone Maila is expected to hit far north Queensland, with the Bureau of Meteorology warning that it could make landfall over the weekend. The storm's path and strength remain uncertain, but it is likely to bring strong winds and heavy rainfall to the area.

The four astronauts on NASA’s Artemis II mission entered the moon’s sphere of influence on Monday, where lunar gravity exerts a stronger pull on the spacecraft than Earth’s. The crew reached this stage four days, six hours, and two minutes into the mission, at a distance of about 62,800 kilometers from the Moon and 373,400 km from Earth.

The latest tvOS 26 updates have brought two new features to Apple TV 4K, including profile upgrades and Genius Browse for TV and movie recommendations. These features have improved the user experience, making it more personalized and convenient.

The developer of Look Outside released an update for April Fools' Day that added a new option to interactions with NPCs: kissing. This feature is now a permanent part of the game, accessible in certain save files or by naming the character 'Casanova'.

You can now generate videos in Gemini, powered by Veo 2. Transform text-based prompts into high-resolution eight-second videos in Gemini Advanced and use Whisk Animate to turn images into eight-second animated clips.

Mailero is a minimal email-first ticketing system designed for solo founders to handle customer support without adding complexity. It allows users to forward their inbox and start replying to tickets instantly, with no setup or workflows required.

Diesel users in Australia are not enjoying the same relief as unleaded customers, with one in 30 service stations still entirely out of diesel and prices rising again after an initial slump last week. The number of service stations without at least one type of fuel fell over the week to Monday from more than 800 to fewer than 600, Guardian analysis shows.
The OpenAI Five Benchmark match is now over. OpenAI Five played against 99.95th percentile Dota players on August 5th in San Francisco.

The Weather Channel has released a new version of its Storm Radar app, introducing a customizable AI weather presenter. The app features hyperlocal weather event notifications and allows users to ask questions about the weather with a chatbot.

OpenAI's first class of scholars is underway, with a group of experienced software developers becoming machine learning practitioners. The scholars will blog about their progress and create an open-source final project.

Lucasfilm co-President Dave Filoni confirmed that season 2 of the Star Wars animated series 'Maul: Shadow Lord' is already in the works. The series explores the story of the Zebrak Sith Lord about a year after the time of the Clone Wars.

macOS 26.4 is the latest Mac software update, which adds three new battery-related features, including Charge Limit, 'Slow Charger' indicator, and the ability to automate your battery's Charge Limit with Shortcuts.

The Xiaomi 17 Ultra features a versatile camera system with a partnership with Leica, and external add-ons that enhance the photography experience. The phone also packs top components, including a Snapdragon 8 Gen 5 processor and a 6.9-inch AMOLED screen.

Glassbrain is a tool for debugging AI apps with a visual trace replay feature. It allows users to click any node, change the input, and replay it without redeploying. The tool also auto-suggests fixes referencing the exact trace data and provides a free tier with 1K traces/month.
Google announces the release of Gemini 2.5 Flash, a new version of its AI model with improved reasoning capabilities. The model is available in preview through the Gemini API and Google AI Studio.

A 65-year-old man's body has been found after he was swept away in flood waters in South Australia's far north. The man, identified as Tony, disappeared on Saturday, sparking a three-day search effort.

The South Korean military has launched its annual defense drills in coordination with government, police, and firefighting agencies to enhance an integrated defense posture across the country. The first phase of the months-long Hwarang defense drills began for a five-day run in the southeastern city of Daegu and North Gyeongsang province.

OpenAI has trained a human-like robot hand to manipulate physical objects with unprecedented dexterity. The system, called Dactyl, is trained entirely in simulation and transfers its knowledge to reality.

NASA's Artemis II mission has successfully completed a key burn of Orion’s main engine, setting it on its path to the moon. The crew will see the far side of the moon humans have never directly seen before on April 6.

This paper presents a large-scale study of purely curiosity-driven learning across 54 standard benchmark environments. The results show surprisingly good performance and a high degree of alignment between the intrinsic curiosity objective and the hand-designed extrinsic rewards of many game environments.
Apple has released an updated beta 1 build for iOS 26.5, just days after the first release. The new build is version 23F5043k and is available for developers to install on their iPhones.

Drivers have accused Euro Car Parks of issuing 'false' parking fines, with some receiving threats from debt collectors despite providing evidence of payment. The company manages over 3,000 car parks across the UK and Ireland.
The Artemis II spacecraft has entered the Moon's sphere of influence, beginning its lunar flyby. The crew will break the record for the farthest humans have traveled from Earth.

As humanity blasts off into a new space race, we need a model of exploration that emphasizes stewardship of other worlds, not exploitation. The Moon meets every criterion for designation as a site of outstanding universal value, with its ancient geology being an irreplaceable scientific archive.

Google introduces new features and improvements to Music AI Sandbox, a set of experimental tools that can spark new creative possibilities and help artists explore unique musical ideas. The tools are designed to be practical, useful, and responsibly created.

The maximum compensation for victims of crime in Great Britain has been capped at £500,000 since 1996, which campaigners say is insufficient for those with severe life-changing injuries. If adjusted for inflation, the maximum would be over £1m.
Apple has added newer iPad Pro models to its refurbished store for a discounted price. The refurbished M4 iPad Pro models offer a nice savings over the current M5 hardware.

NASA's Artemis II mission has launched and is currently on a 10-day journey around the Moon, marking a major step towards humanity's return to the lunar surface. The mission has already encountered some issues, including a malfunctioning toilet and problems with Microsoft Outlook.

OpenAI Five lost two games against top Dota 2 players at The International in Vancouver, maintaining a good chance of winning for the first 20–35 minutes of both games. The games were exciting and close, showing that even though Five teaches itself Dota from scratch, its playstyle results in incredible gameplay versus the best professionals.

Our first cohort of OpenAI Scholars has completed the program, producing exciting final projects and going on to work or teach within machine learning. A Scholars Demo Day will be held to showcase their work.

Trains were reportedly leaving Southern Cross rail station in Melbourne jammed full at the weekend, with passengers forced to stand for up to five hours. The reduced public holiday services and school holidays have heightened pressure on the network, leading to overcrowding.

Anadolu’s recap of top stories from around the globe, including 15 ships transiting the Strait of Hormuz and a social media post by US President Donald Trump raising speculation about a possible announcement on Iran. Clashes broke out between Iranian forces and US troops during a rescue operation of an American pilot.

Apple is rumored to be releasing new AirPods Pro this year with features like built-in IR cameras, hand gestures, and a new H3 chip. The new model is expected to be a higher-end version of AirPods Pro 3.

Samsung is bringing blood pressure monitoring to Galaxy Watches in the US for the first time, available on Galaxy Watch 4 and newer models running Wear OS 4 or later. The feature relies on calibration with a traditional cuff-based monitor for accuracy.

The Archive of Our Own website has exited its open beta phase after 17 years, now hosting 17 million fan-created works and having 10 million registered users. The website has added several features over the years, including a tagging system and the ability to download fanworks in various formats.

Google has released an updated version of Gemini 2.5 Pro, which has improved capabilities for coding and building interactive web apps. The update is available in the Gemini API and Vertex AI, and is also accessible in the Gemini app.

The US, Iran, and regional mediators are discussing a possible 45-day ceasefire that could lead to a permanent end to the war. The proposed agreement has two phases: a 45-day ceasefire and a permanent settlement addressing Iran’s uranium stockpile and the reopening of the Strait of Hormuz.

Up to 9.6 million UK workers are to benefit from changes to sick pay rules, with 8.4 million workers who rely on statutory sick pay to be paid from their first day of falling ill rather than from day four. The changes are part of the Employment Rights Act 2025.
NASA's Artemis II mission has launched, marking a new era of lunar exploration. The mission aims to send humans to the Moon and conduct various scientific experiments.

Apple has released the first iOS 26.5 public beta, which includes new features such as a "Suggested Places" feature in Maps and end-to-end encryption for RCS in the Messages app. The update is available for public beta testers.
Apple is celebrating its 50th anniversary and the company remains committed to personal computing. The Engadget Podcast discusses Apple's history and future in the tech industry.

Switzerland's Foreign Ministry will summon Israel's ambassador in response to the Israeli parliament’s approval of a death penalty law for Palestinians convicted of fatal attacks. The introduction of the death penalty by Israel has drawn strong criticism internationally, including from Switzerland.

A promising class of generative models maps points from a simple distribution to a complex distribution through an invertible neural network. The result is a continuous-time invertible generative model with unbiased density estimation and one-pass sampling, while allowing unrestricted neural network architectures.

Iran's parliamentary speaker condemns Donald Trump's threats to target energy and transport infrastructure, while Netanyahu suggests Israel assisted the US with its rescue of the downed airman in Iran.

OpenAI is now accepting applications for its second cohort of OpenAI Scholars, a program providing stipends and mentorship to individuals from underrepresented groups to study deep learning. The program aims to improve diversity in the field of AI.

The public beta of macOS 26.5 is now available for users. This release appears to be focused on bug fixes and stability improvements, with no significant new features introduced so far. Users can install the public beta by enrolling in Apple’s public beta program and following the step-by-step instructions provided.
Apple has just released public beta 1 for iPadOS 26.5, watchOS 26.5, and more. The updates follow the launch of corresponding 26.5 developer betas earlier this week.

Google has released an updated version of Gemini 2.5 Pro, which features improved coding capabilities and stronger front-end web development. The new version is available for developers to start building with before Google I/O later this month.
The Super Mario Galaxy Movie lacks creativity and storytelling, making it a disappointing sequel. The movie fails to deliver entertainment value, with too much repetition and not enough originality.

WHO Member States have agreed to extend negotiations on the Pathogen Access and Benefit Sharing (PABS) annex to the WHO Pandemic Agreement, with discussions to resume in late-April ahead of its scheduled consideration by the World Health Assembly (WHA) in May.

The 2027 budget proposed by the Trump administration would make deep cuts to many science agencies. The plan proposes cuts to federal agencies that fund or conduct research on health, space and the environment.

Apple TV is bringing back three series this summer, including Ted Lasso season 4, Sugar season 2, and Women in Blue season 2. Ted Lasso season 4 will premiere in August, while Sugar season 2 will premiere on June 19 and Women in Blue season 2 will premiere on August 12.

OpenAI proposes an AI safety technique called iterated amplification to specify complicated behaviors and goals beyond human scale. The method generates a training signal for tasks under certain assumptions, allowing humans to identify smaller components of a task and provide indirect supervision.

The Trump administration's labor board has ordered Amazon to recognize and bargain with the International Brotherhood of Teamsters union, which represents workers at a warehouse in Staten Island. This is just the latest chapter in a multiyear standoff between Staten Island warehouse workers and Amazon.

OpenAI develops Random Network Distillation, a prediction-based method for encouraging reinforcement learning agents to explore their environments through curiosity, achieving state-of-the-art performance on Montezuma's Revenge. The method exceeds average human performance on the game for the first time without using demonstrations or access to the underlying state of the game.

iFixit has torn down the new AirPods Max 2, finding largely unchanged innards. The company notes that while the design of the headphones remains the same, the internals have been updated with new hardware such as the H2 chip.

Google is extending Gemini to become a world model that can make plans and imagine new experiences by simulating aspects of the world. The company is working to integrate capabilities like video understanding, screen sharing, and memory into Gemini Live.

Explosions were heard in Iran's capital, Tehran, after US and Israeli forces launched an attack. The blasts occurred in the southern and western areas of the city, with no official statement issued on the damage caused.

A fuel tanker crashed into another vehicle, toppled power lines, and burst into flames outside Fort Worth, Texas. The truck was carrying 9,000 gallons of gasoline at the time of the collision. The driver was hospitalized with burns and is in critical condition.

Mission scientists spoke to Nature about the geological features they’re most excited for the crew to observe. The astronauts aboard NASA’s Artemis II mission will fly around the far side of the Moon, the first time humans have visited since 1972.
Developer Undead Labs will hold a series of playtests beginning next month. State of Decay 3 is still in the pipeline despite Microsoft's hacking and slashing of its Xbox division.

Israel has incurred around $15 billion in costs since the start of its wars against Iran and Lebanon's Hezbollah group. The cost is expected to rise as fighting continues and the economic repercussions deepen.

Eight young futures hubs aimed at giving young people support towards work and away from street crime are to open across England, ministers have announced. The youth centres are supposed to help people aged up to 18 with employment advice, health and wellbeing, and are also aimed at preventing them from falling into a life of crime.

The POLO framework enables efficient learning and exploration in complex control tasks by combining local model-based control, global value function learning, and exploration. This approach allows for fast and stable learning of value functions in simulated control tasks.
Google has announced the SynthID Detector, a new portal to help identify AI-generated content. The portal can detect AI-generated images, audio, and text created using Google's AI tools.

Hezbollah has struck a warship in the eastern Mediterranean with a cruise missile, according to Israeli media. The Lebanese group said it targeted an Israeli military warship, while Israel's Channel 14 claimed the vessel was British. The incident occurred off the Lebanese coast, with Hezbollah saying it used a naval cruise missile after monitoring the target for several hours.

OpenAI releases Spinning Up in Deep RL, an educational resource designed to help people learn deep reinforcement learning. The resource includes examples of RL code, educational exercises, documentation, and tutorials.
OpenAI releases CoinRun, a training environment to quantify an agent's ability to transfer its experience to novel situations. CoinRun provides a metric for generalization in reinforcement learning.

The NHS is urging patients not to put off seeking care as resident doctors in England prepare for a six-day strike over pay. The strike is expected to be particularly challenging due to a shorter notice period.

Scientists have discovered a protein called FTL1 that drives brain aging, and reducing it can restore memory performance in mice. The protein weakens connections between brain cells, leading to memory decline in aging mice.

Iran's Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps Navy said the Strait of Hormuz will never return to its previous status, particularly for the US and Israel. The force is finalizing operational preparations for a new security arrangement in the Persian Gulf.

Councils in England have been urged to crack down on the misuse of blue badge parking permits, with the proportion of people holding them reaching one in 15. The AA has called for more to be done to detect offences such as people using fake or stolen badges.
The Artemis II crew is almost at the moon and has been taking in the views from the Orion spacecraft's windows. The spacecraft will reach the moon's vicinity shortly after midnight on Monday.

The 9to5Mac Daily podcast discusses Apple's laptop shipments and other top stories. Apple is expected to outperform the broader notebook market amid a downturn. The company's fitness chief, Jay Blahnik, is retiring in July after 13 years.

Gemini 2.5 Flash and Pro are now generally available, and we’re introducing 2.5 Flash-Lite, our most cost-efficient and fastest 2.5 model yet. The new models provide amazing performance while being at the Pareto Frontier of cost and speed.

The Jerusalem Governorate said seven documented attempts were made during this year’s Jewish Passover to bring sacrificial animals into Al-Aqsa Mosque. Israeli authorities kept both Al-Aqsa Mosque and the Church of the Holy Sepulchre closed for a 37th consecutive day, citing security concerns.
Moira Deeming has secured the top spot on the Victorian Liberal ticket, while Chris Bowen has called for the reopening of the Strait of Hormuz amid ongoing tensions in the Middle East.

Our first cohort of OpenAI Fellows has concluded, with each Fellow going from a machine learning beginner to core OpenAI contributor in the course of a 6-month apprenticeship. All 6 Fellows have authored or contributed to papers and completed projects investigating a novel research idea while embedded in an OpenAI research team.

US President Donald Trump has extended a deadline for Iran to open the Strait of Hormuz, amid a slew of threats and a complex rescue operation to retrieve a downed US airman. The situation remains tense, with Iran blocking the strait and the US warning of extensive attacks on Iranian energy infrastructure if the deadline is not met.

OpenAI argues that long-term AI safety research needs social scientists to ensure AI alignment algorithms succeed when actual humans are involved. The goal is to spark further collaboration between machine learning and social science researchers.

Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu criticized a decision by the High Court of Justice to allow an anti-war protest to take place in Tel Aviv. The protest was against the ongoing US-Israeli war against Iran and Lebanon.

US politicians have reacted with alarm to Donald Trump's threat to Iran, with some questioning his mental state. The threat came after Trump wrote an expletive-laden message on social media, calling on Iran to 'open the fuckin’ strait' or face consequences.

DeepMind introduces Gemini Robotics On-Device, a powerful VLA model optimized to run locally on robotic devices, bringing AI into the physical world. The model achieves strong general-purpose dexterity and task generalization, and is adaptable to new tasks through fine-tuning.

Google is releasing the Gemini 2.5 Computer Use model via the Gemini API, enabling developers to build agents that can interact with user interfaces. This model outperforms others in web and mobile control benchmarks with lower latency.

The Council on American-Islamic Relations (CAIR) condemned US President Donald Trump's 'inflammatory' post and called on Congress to reconvene to end the Iran war. CAIR said Trump's threats to attack civilian infrastructure were 'reckless, dangerous' and reflected 'indifference to human life and contempt for religious beliefs.'

Amazon will continue with 'Lord of the Rings: The Rings of Power' for its full five-season run. The show is considered a priority by Amazon CEO Jeff Bezos. A planned spinoff has been canceled to make way for the main series.

Nasa administrator Jared Isaacman says odds of evidence we are not alone are ‘pretty high’ four days after Artemis II rocket lifted off. The US space agency plans its missions with the possibility of alien existence in mind.
The Artemis II crew took stunning pictures of Earth while on their mission around the Moon. The photos show a striking view of our planet and its features, including auroras and zodiacal light.

A suspected measles outbreak in Bangladesh has killed over 110 children, prompting the government to launch a nationwide emergency vaccination campaign. The campaign aims to immunize over 1.3 million children in high-risk communities.

OpenAI has created activation atlases, a new technique for visualizing interactions between neurons in neural networks. This technique helps to better understand the internal decision-making processes of AI systems. Activation atlases can be used to identify weaknesses and investigate failures in neural networks.

President Trump has issued an expletive-laden warning to Iran, stating that they must reopen the strait of Hormuz by Tuesday or face severe consequences. The threat comes as tensions between the US and Iran continue to escalate. Iran has responded, warning that the region will burn if the US continues its reckless moves.

The 'Kamen Rider' franchise is expanding with new movies, shows, and weekly drops for two legacy series. Toei and Ishimori Productions are celebrating the 55th birthday of the tokusatsu series with big plans for its future.

Google Research introduces VaultGemma, the largest open model trained from scratch with differential privacy, providing a significant step forward in building AI that is both powerful and private by design. VaultGemma represents a new understanding of the scaling laws for DP, enabling the community to build the next generation of safe, responsible, and private AI.

Ukraine and Syria have agreed to reopen their embassies in each other's capitals. The agreement was made during a meeting between Ukrainian Foreign Minister Andrii Sybiha and his Syrian counterpart Asaad Hassan al-Shaibani in Damascus. They discussed security, logistics, trade, and food security.

The Australian Human Rights Commission is investigating a complaint against the New South Wales multiculturalism minister and his department over allegations of racial discrimination against organisations representing south Asian Muslims and caste-oppressed Hindu communities. The complaint alleges the minister and department failed to investigate allegations about the Hindu Council of Australia and minimised concerns raised by Muslim and caste-oppressed communities.

Elon Musk has set a condition for banks working on SpaceX's IPO, requiring them to subscribe to Grok, a chatbot with a controversial history. The banks are said to have agreed to spend tens of millions of dollars on the service.

OpenAI has created a new entity called OpenAI LP, a hybrid of a for-profit and nonprofit, to ensure that artificial general intelligence benefits all of humanity. The company's mission comes first, and it has designed its structure to prioritize safety and beneficial AGI.

Thousands of people gathered at the steps of the Texas capitol to protest against the construction of a border wall through Big Bend, in a show of bipartisan opposition to the White House’s plans. The protest was met with support from both Democrats and Republicans, with many speaking out against the potential harm the wall could cause to the environment and local communities.

A Democratic congressman criticized Polymarket for allowing users to bet on the date the United States would confirm the rescue of Air Force service members shot down over Iran. The company has since taken down the market, citing a failure to meet its integrity standards.
The Gemini app now has a new image editing model from Google DeepMind. This update focuses on maintaining a consistent likeness when editing photos of people and pets.
A falling tree killed 3 people, including a 10-month-old baby, at an Easter event in Germany. The incident occurred near Satrupholm, where around 50 people gathered for the event.
Los Thuthanaka's new EP Wak'a is a mellow follow-up to their surprise Pitchfork favorite. The EP interprets the Aymara legend of the first sunrise over three songs.

Keir Starmer has used a series of new workers rights to attack the Green party, saying a vote for Labour’s rivals puts such progress on sick pay, parental leave and zero-hours contracts at risk. The prime minister also took a swipe at business figures and opponents of what he described as the biggest strengthening of workers’ rights in a generation.

Microsoft's Copilot is labeled as for entertainment purposes only in its terms of use, warning users not to rely on it for important advice. The company plans to update this language as the product evolves.

Jason Blundell, a former creative lead on Activision Blizzard's Call of Duty: Black Ops series, has announced that he's formed a new development studio called Magic Fractal Studios. The studio was announced on a livestream with former Dark Outlaw Games coworker JC Farmer, a little over a week after the previous studio was closed by Sony.

Seven people have been arrested under suspicion of supporting the banned group Palestine Action after a protest in Suffolk. The protest was organised after media reports that a US fighter jet shot down in Iran on Friday had taken off from the Lakenheath base.
A growing number of apps aim to help people form platonic connections, as loneliness and social isolation become more prevalent. Some notable examples include Timeleft, Meet5, and Bumble’s BFF.

The UK government is trying to sway the San Francisco-based AI company to expand its presence on English soil. According to a report, staffers at the UK's Department for Science, Innovation and Technology have worked on proposals that include expanding Anthropic's office in London, along with a potential dual stock listing.

China has issued a 40-day shutdown notice for offshore airspace without providing an explanation. The alerts are in effect from March 27 through May 6 and cover an area larger than Taiwan’s main island, including offshore airspace north and south of Shanghai.

Google introduces Gemma 3 270M, a compact AI model designed for task-specific fine-tuning with strong instruction-following and text structuring capabilities. The model has 270 million parameters and is optimized for low power consumption, making it suitable for on-device and research applications.

OpenAI announces its 2019 class of scholars, a group of eight individuals with diverse backgrounds and expertise in fields such as literature, philosophy, and machine learning. The scholars will work on various projects, including applying reinforcement learning to robotic manipulation and improving inference and reasoning in natural language processing.

MuseNet is a deep neural network that can generate 4-minute musical compositions with 10 different instruments, and can combine styles from country to Mozart to the Beatles. It was trained on hundreds of thousands of MIDI files and can create new compositions in various styles.

Serbia has said it found explosives near a pipeline that carries Russian natural gas to Hungary, sparking claims of a possible 'false flag' operation aimed at influencing Hungary's elections. Hungary's prime minister, Viktor Orbán, is trailing in the polls before next Sunday's election.

US President Donald Trump says he does not consider it necessary to deploy ground troops to Iran at this stage, but he refused to rule it out. Trump told ABC News that he is not ruling out sending ground troops if Iran fails to reach a deal with Washington.
Toonstar, an AI animation studio, is partnering with HarperCollins to adapt books into digital shows. The first project will be an adaptation of Lisa Greenwald's "Friendship List" series.

Samsung's approach to its Galaxy Watch lineup feels self-defeating, with some top health features exclusive to Samsung phone users. The brand's restrictions on features like ECG and blood pressure tracking are outdated and frustrating for users who pair their Galaxy Watch with non-Samsung phones.

Current AI benchmarks struggle to keep pace with modern models. Google DeepMind and Kaggle are introducing the Kaggle Game Arena, a public AI benchmarking platform where AI models compete in strategic games. The platform provides a verifiable and dynamic measure of AI capabilities.

Ukraine has rejected attempts to link it to explosives found near the Serbia-Hungary gas pipeline, calling it a Russian false-flag operation. The incident occurred ahead of Hungary's general elections.

Israeli strikes across southern Lebanon and the capital, Beirut, have killed at least 14 people. The strikes come after Israel threatened to hit Lebanon’s main border crossing with Syria, forcing its closure. Lebanese armed group Hezbollah fires projectiles at northern Israel while Israeli troops push deeper into southern Lebanon.
