Samsung is discontinuing its Messages app in July and recommends users switch to Google Messages. The change brings features like RCS messaging and generative AI to Samsung users.

The rescue of the second crew member of a downed F-15 fighter jet in Iran is a propaganda coup for the US, but the incident is also a reminder that Iran can fight back and inflict costs on the US. The downing of the jet is a rare occurrence, and the US has been bombing Iran heavily in recent weeks.

SpaceX has reportedly filed confidential paperwork for an initial public offering in which the company would raise $75 billion at a $1.75 trillion valuation. According to CEO Elon Musk, orbital data centers will be a big part of SpaceX’s future.

Researchers study the transfer of adversarial robustness of deep neural networks between different perturbation types. The study evaluates 32 attacks of 5 different types against models adversarially trained on a 100-class subset of ImageNet.
Turkish Foreign Minister Hakan Fidan met with Syrian President Ahmad al-Sharaa and Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy in Damascus. The meeting's details have not been disclosed.
Pope Leo XIV used his first Easter mass at the Vatican to urge global leaders to “choose peace”. The Pope warned that the world is growing accustomed to violence and becoming indifferent to it.

Humans see faces in everyday objects due to a phenomenon called face pareidolia, where the brain is primed to detect facial features. Research suggests that people are more likely to see faces in symmetrical images and objects, and that the face-selective network in the brain is geared towards detecting two eyes, a nose, and a mouth.

Suno's AI music platform can generate covers of popular songs that are alarmingly close to the originals, making it easy to flood streaming services with unauthorized content. The platform's copyright filters are easy to fool, allowing users to upload tracks that are nearly identical to well-known hits.

The issue of remote assistance is not a Waymo issue, it’s an autonomous vehicle technology issue. A new report from Sen. Ed Markey makes this point. Markey sent letters to seven U.S. companies working on autonomous vehicle technology with a list of questions. They all refused to say how often their vehicles relied on input from remote staff.

Deep Think is now available in the Gemini app for Google AI Ultra subscribers, offering improved problem-solving capabilities through parallel thinking and novel reinforcement learning techniques. The model has achieved state-of-the-art performance in various benchmarks, including coding, science, and math.

A family court has ruled that an Aboriginal child who was moved 1,700km from his remote Northern Territory community should be returned to ensure he can experience his culture. The boy, known as X, was born in 2016 and has been living with a woman in Western Australia. The court found that X should be returned to his community, known as Town N, to learn about his culture and take part in men's business.

The latest installment in the Super Meat Boy series has been released, along with several other new indie games. Super Meat Boy 3D is a tough precision platformer with a new dimension and fixed perspective, while other games like Raccoin and Tombwater offer unique gameplay experiences.

Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy met with his Syrian counterpart, Ahmad al-Sharaa, in Damascus to collaborate on security and development. They discussed the situation in the region and the Russia-Ukraine conflict.

The second class of OpenAI Fellows has completed their 6-month apprenticeship, with each Fellow going from a machine learning beginner to core OpenAI contributor. The Fellows have completed projects investigating novel research ideas while embedded in an OpenAI research team.

Trump's mass deportation plan has led to the arrest of dozens of people in rural western Wisconsin, causing fear and disruption in small towns. Local residents are organizing to support affected families and calling for their local officials to take action.

NASA's Artemis II mission has begun its 10-day journey around the moon, and a group of undergraduate students has discovered one of the oldest stars ever observed. The Artemis II crew is now more than halfway to the moon, and the students' discovery provides an unprecedented look at conditions in the early universe.
AI-generated ‘Expert Reviews’ weren’t a hit with users or experts. Grammarly's feature used famous names without permission, sparking outrage and a lawsuit.

Somalia's first offshore oil drilling campaign carries both economic and geopolitical significance. The Turkish drill ship Cagri Bey has arrived in Somalia's territorial waters to begin the first offshore drilling in the country.

Google DeepMind is partnering with Commonwealth Fusion Systems to bring clean, safe, and limitless fusion energy closer to reality. The partnership aims to use AI to optimize the performance of a tokamak, a device that uses magnetic fields to confine and heat plasma to achieve fusion reactions.

Japan is pushing physical AI from pilot projects into real-world deployment due to labor shortages. The country aims to build a domestic physical AI sector and capture a 30% share of the global market by 2040.

The UK has detained 76 children under the 'one in, one out' scheme, which allows for the forced removal of migrants to France in exchange for another migrant being brought to the UK legally. Concerns have been raised over the detention of minors in adult detention centers.

Serbian military and police officers have found a cache of highly powerful explosives not far from a pipeline that carries Russian natural gas from Turkey to Hungary. The discovery was made near the Hungarian border in northern Serbia.

The second class of OpenAI Scholars has concluded, with all eight scholars producing an exciting final project showcased at Scholars Demo Day at OpenAI. The scholars demonstrated core technical skills across various expert domains and self-motivation, showing how accessible machine learning is.

US President Donald Trump offers threats but no clear plan to end the crisis, leaving markets unsettled as disruption from the Strait of Hormuz closure spreads beyond Asia and into Europe. Economist James Meadway says the situation is causing uncertainty and concern.

The author tested Gemini in Google Maps and found it to be a useful tool for planning a day out in the city, despite some minor issues with accuracy. Gemini suggested a variety of activities and locations, including a taco restaurant, a park, and a coffee shop.

Amano's Devils on the Moon Pinball is a detailed pinball game for the Playdate, with simple controls and a distinct visual identity. The game's physics and table design are impressive, making it a great option for pinball fans.

Elections seem top-of-mind for the Maha movement as key polling indicates anti-vaccine views are a liability. US health officials appear to be shying away from voicing negative views of vaccines in public as November’s midterm elections loom.

Russia and Ukraine traded accusations of air attacks, each claiming to have hit the opponent's energy infrastructure. The Russian Defense Ministry said it carried out strikes on Ukrainian airfields and energy infrastructure, while Ukraine reported a drone attack on an oil refinery and pipeline in Russia.

Gemini Robotics 1.5 introduces two models that unlock agentic experiences with advanced thinking, enabling robots to perceive, plan, think, use tools and act to better solve complex tasks. The models, Gemini Robotics 1.5 and Gemini Robotics-ER 1.5, work together to perform complex tasks in the physical world.
The Slate Truck is a two-seater electric pickup with no paint, no radio, and no power windows. It's minimal, but is it too minimal?

The UK government is to break a manifesto commitment to ban foie gras imports and has declined to stop fur imports, after the EU made these red lines in its discussions for a trade deal. Animal welfare charities say they are bitterly disappointed that ministers are failing to use powers granted by Brexit to restrict the import of these cruel items.

Iran's Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps (IRGC) threatened “more devastating” attacks on US economic interests in the region if Iranian civilian facilities are attacked again. The force said in a statement that Iranian attacks on gas and petrochemicals plants in the United Arab Emirates, Kuwait and Bahrain were in retaliation for US-Israeli strikes on civilian facilities in Iran.

A public Quizlet set appears to have exposed confidential information about security procedures in US Customs and Border Protection facilities. The set was available to the public until it was made private after WIRED messaged a phone number potentially linked to the Quizlet user.

Microsoft is investing $1 billion in OpenAI to support building artificial general intelligence with widely distributed economic benefits. The partnership will develop a hardware and software platform within Microsoft Azure to scale to AGI.
The story of the Echo’s development inside Amazon and its surprise launch and immediate success. The Echo speaker and the Alexa voice assistant brought a new kind of computer to millions of people.

Proposals to deploy reflective mirrors and up to 1m more satellites in low Earth orbit could have far-reaching consequences for human health and ecosystems. Scientists have raised concerns in letters to the US Federal Communications Commission (FCC) about the potential disruption to sleep and circadian rhythms, as well as the impact on nocturnal species and ocean food webs.

Researchers at Google DeepMind have developed a new method to tackle long-standing challenges in mathematics, physics, and engineering using AI techniques. The approach has led to the discovery of new families of unstable singularities in fluid dynamics.

A little-noticed clause in sweeping changes to Germany’s military service policy has caused uproar after it emerged that the law requires men aged up to 45 to get permission from the armed forces before any significant stay abroad, even in peacetime.

Türkiye and four other nations condemned the recent killing of three Indonesian peacekeepers serving with the UN Interim Force in Lebanon. The foreign ministers of the five nations expressed their deepest condolences and sympathy to the families of the victims.

OpenAI has developed a method to assess whether a neural network classifier can reliably defend against adversarial attacks not seen during training. The method yields a new metric, UAR, which evaluates the robustness of a single model against an unanticipated attack.
The war in Iran is pushing up the cost of living in the UK, and also driving up funeral costs due to higher gas prices. The average traditional funeral now costs £4,623, up 1.3% since January.

Iranian media claims clashes with US forces during a rescue operation of an American pilot, with several US assets reportedly destroyed. The incident occurred after a US C-130 support aircraft was downed in southern Isfahan, Iran.

Google DeepMind introduces Deep Loop Shaping, a novel AI method to improve control of gravitational wave observatories, helping astronomers better understand the dynamics and formation of the universe. The method reduces noise and improves control in an observatory's feedback system.

The former boss of the Co-op collected almost £2m before her sudden departure last month despite a difficult year when the retailer was pushed into the red by a damaging cyber hack. Shirine Khoury-Haq’s total annual pay package amounted to £1.9m in 2025, including a £165,000 “rewarding growth” bonus.

Former US House Speaker Nancy Pelosi says President Donald Trump cannot withdraw the US from NATO without congressional approval, criticizing his threats to leave the alliance as "shortsighted." Trump's threats to leave NATO are a gift to Russian President Vladimir Putin, according to Pelosi.

OpenAI has trained a pair of neural networks to solve the Rubik’s Cube with a human-like robot hand. The neural networks are trained entirely in simulation using reinforcement learning and can handle situations it never saw during training.

Storm Dave has left thousands of homes across Wales and Northern Ireland without power and disrupted road and rail travel across the UK. The storm brought high winds and snow, with winds of up to 93mph recorded in Capel Curig in north Wales.

Spanish athlete Adel Mechaal wins men's race, Turkish runner Derya Kunur claims victory in women's category in 10-km event. The winners praised the event, saying it was well-organized and the course was truly beautiful.

Introducing Aeneas, the first model for contextualizing ancient inscriptions, designed to help historians better interpret and restore fragmentary texts. Aeneas is a multimodal generative neural network that takes an inscription’s text and image as input.

The Mexican art world is protesting a plan to send Frida Kahlo masterpieces to Spain. Cultural figures are calling on the government for clarity on the deal, which they fear could lead to the works being lost to Mexico forever.

Anthropic is no longer offering a free ride for third-party apps using its Claude AI. The creator of Claude Code said this change is meant to manage the growth in demand for Anthropic. Users of OpenClaw, a free and open-source AI assistant, will have to buy a usage bundle or switch to another AI integration.

Keir Starmer has expressed concern over Kanye West's upcoming performance at Wireless festival due to the rapper's past antisemitic remarks. West has been booked to headline the festival despite his history of controversy.

OpenAI releases the largest version of GPT-2, a language model with 1.5B parameters, to facilitate detection of synthetic text. The model has been found to be convincing, with humans giving it a credibility score of 6.91 out of 10. However, detection of synthetic text is still a challenge.

Iran announced Sunday that it would await FIFA's guarantees for participation in the 2026 FIFA World Cup. The country's sports minister stated that their request to relocate Iran's games from the US to Mexico is still valid, but they have not yet received a response from FIFA.

An advanced version of Gemini with Deep Think has achieved a gold-medal standard at the International Mathematical Olympiad, solving five out of six problems perfectly and earning 35 total points. This breakthrough demonstrates the potential of AI to contribute to mathematics and advance human knowledge.
The upcoming OS will add Suggested Places and ads in Apple Maps. Apple has released the first public beta for iOS 26.5, just a few days after the beta for developers came out.

The UK's relationship with social media is changing, with a rise in passive consumption and concerns over mental health and past posts. Ofcom data shows that UK adults are becoming less active on social media platforms, with 49% of users now posting, sharing or commenting, compared to 61% in 2024.

OpenAI releases Safety Gym, a suite of environments and tools for measuring progress towards reinforcement learning agents that respect safety constraints while training. Safety Gym provides a standardized method of comparing algorithms and how well they avoid costly mistakes while learning.
Influcio is an AI marketing agent for result-driven influencer campaigns. It replaces one-off influencer campaigns with a self-learning AI system.

AlphaEarth Foundations is a new AI model that integrates petabytes of Earth observation data to generate a unified data representation, revolutionizing global mapping and monitoring. The model provides a powerful new lens for understanding our planet, solving two major challenges: data overload and inconsistent information.

Paris has undergone a significant transformation in recent years, adding bike lanes and pedestrianizing streets to reduce its reliance on cars. The city's efforts have been recognized as a model for other cities to follow, but not without challenges and controversy.

Saudi Arabia has shot down a cruise missile amid ongoing escalation in the region. The incident comes as hostilities have escalated since the US and Israel launched a joint offensive on Iran, killing over 1,340 people to date.

A new MIT course, AI and Rationality, challenges students to explore philosophical problems through the lens of AI research. The course examines the disputed definition of rationality and its implications for AI decision-making.

Apple acquired MotionVFX, a popular Final Cut Pro plugin maker, which could be integrated into Apple Creator Studio. This acquisition may indicate Apple's renewed interest in investing in pro software, potentially with a subscription incentive.

Ministers are working with Labour backbenchers to secure more exemptions to Shabana Mahmood's immigration changes, which would make it harder to achieve settled status in the UK. The plans have sparked widespread anger among Labour MPs, with many calling for exemptions for people who have already entered the UK.

Reinforcement learning agents need to explore their environments to learn optimal policies by trial and error, and safety is a critical concern in many environments. This work proposes to standardize constrained RL as the main formalism for safe exploration and presents the Safety Gym benchmark suite.

Iran claimed on Sunday that it shot down a US C-130 support aircraft in the southern area of Isfahan. The plane was destroyed by heavy fire from a police special forces unit, according to Iranian police.

MIT researchers have created a model that suggests promising ways to synthesize new materials for faster experimentation. The model, called DiffSyn, uses an approach in AI known as diffusion to guide scientists through the process of making materials by suggesting promising synthesis routes.

Google DeepMind partnered with Primordial Soup to produce a short film premiering at the Tribeca Festival, combining live-action with video generated by Veo, Google's video generation model. The film, “ANCESTRA,” tells the story of a mother and what happens when her child is born with a hole in its heart.

The Fair Work Agency is being launched on Tuesday, but its priorities have been criticised for focusing on reducing regulatory burdens on businesses rather than protecting workers' rights. The agency's incoming chair, Matthew Taylor, has listed the government's priorities, which include 'thought leadership' and 'reducing regulatory burdens'.

The US Army Chief of Staff Gen. Randy George has retired immediately after being asked to resign by Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth. In his farewell email, George said US troops deserve brave and principled leadership.

The Singapore-MIT Alliance for Research and Technology has launched a new research project to develop a wearable ultrasound imaging system for monitoring chronic conditions in real-time. This system aims to enable earlier detection and timely intervention, transforming elderly care.
A Waitrose employee of 17 years has been sacked after stopping a shoplifter who had filled a bag with Lindt Gold Bunny Easter eggs. Walker Smith, 54, grabbed the bag from the thief, who then escaped.
US President Donald Trump issues 48-hour ultimatum to Iran over Strait of Hormuz, Iran approves humanitarian passage through the strait, and Kuwait is hit by an Iranian drone attack.

OpenAI releases Procgen Benchmark, a set of 16 procedurally-generated environments to measure generalization in reinforcement learning. The benchmark provides a direct measure of how quickly a reinforcement learning agent learns generalizable skills.
The US and Israel are at war with Iran, with the conflict escalating by the day. Iran has rejected Trump's ultimatum, and the situation remains volatile.

Architecture students bring new forms of human-machine interaction into the kitchen. They designed a device named Kitchen Cosmo, which functions as a recipe generator and allows users to input information such as dietary preferences and skill level.

The AI for Math Initiative brings together five of the world's most prestigious research institutions to pioneer the use of AI in mathematical research. The initiative aims to accelerate discovery in mathematical research by combining the profound intuition of world-leading mathematicians with the novel capabilities of AI.

Asian trading partners have reassured Australia that the “normal supply” of fuel will continue amid the Middle East conflict, as the government prepares to intensify efforts to avert shortages of petrol and diesel. The federal government has been chasing supply guarantees from countries including Singapore, South Korea, Malaysia and Japan as the Iran war and closure of the strait of Hormuz wreaks havoc on the global oil market.
The US has rescued a second F-15 pilot who was hit above Iran, according to President Donald Trump. The rescue operation involved dozens of heavily armed aircraft.

MIT senior Katie Spivakovsky has been selected as a 2026-27 Churchill Scholar and will undertake an MPhil in biological sciences at the Wellcome Sanger Institute at Cambridge University in the U.K. this fall. She aims to integrate computation and bioengineering in an academic research career focused on developing robust, scalable solutions that promote equitable health outcomes.

Ninety-three service stations in New South Wales are facing fines for misrepresenting their prices amid Australia’s fuel crisis. A two-week compliance blitz has seen inspectors visit about 75% of stations registered with fuel price app FuelCheck in NSW.

US special operations forces rescued the second crew member of an F-15 fighter jet downed above Iran. The rescue capped a tense 36-hour operation in southwest Iran, where US forces and Iran’s Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps were reportedly trying to reach the missing American officer.

Researchers at OpenAI have discovered a phenomenon called deep double descent, where the performance of a model first improves, then gets worse, and then improves again with increasing model size, data size, or training time. This effect is often avoided through careful regularization.

US President Donald Trump has issued another threat to Iran, writing that it has two days to make a deal or open up the Hormuz Strait. The threat comes as the search for a US pilot who is believed to have ejected over Iran after an F-15 fighter jet crashed in the country continues.
The first reactions to 'Maul: Shadow Lord' are in, with critics praising the show's dark vibes and visuals. The series follows Maul as he tries to rebuild his criminal empire on the planet Janix.

Professor James Collins discusses how collaboration has been central to his research into combining computational predictions with new experimental platforms to accelerate the discovery and design of therapeutic drugs. Collins' research has led to the development of new classes of diagnostics and therapeutics, including in the detection and treatment of pathogens like Ebola, Zika, SARS-CoV-2, and antibiotic-resistant bacteria.

OpenAI's CEO of AGI deployment, Fidji Simo, is taking medical leave for several weeks. The company is undergoing major leadership restructuring, with president Greg Brockman handling product teams in Simo's absence.
Google is using AI to help protect the planet's ecosystems and species. The company is developing new AI-powered tools to map species, predict deforestation, and monitor the health of ecosystems.
VariAlarm is an app that dynamically adjusts your alarms based on your schedule. It eliminates the need to constantly toggle multiple alarms and supports syncing with Apple Calendar.

Antonio Torralba and three MIT alumni have been named 2025 ACM Fellows for their outstanding contributions to computing and information technology. Torralba's research focuses on computer vision, machine learning, and human visual perception.

Iran has rejected Donald Trump’s demand that the regime cut a deal in 48 hours or face “all hell”. The US president had given Iran an ultimatum, which was rejected by Iran’s central military command. The conflict in the Middle East continues to escalate.

Researchers at OpenAI studied empirical scaling laws for language model performance on the cross-entropy loss, finding that the loss scales as a power-law with model size, dataset size, and compute used for training. Larger models are significantly more sample-efficient, allowing for optimal allocation of a fixed compute budget.

OpenAI introduces Microscope, a collection of visualizations of every significant layer and neuron of eight vision models, to help the research community understand neural networks. Microscope makes it easier to analyze the features that form inside these neural networks.

Brian Hedden has been appointed co-associate dean of the Social and Ethical Responsibilities of Computing at MIT. He joins Nikos Trichakis in guiding the cross-cutting initiative of the MIT Schwarzman College of Computing. Hedden's research focuses on how we ought to form beliefs and make decisions, and it explores how philosophical thinking about rationality can yield insights into contemporary ethical issues, including ethics of AI.

Ireland is testing a digital wallet that can store official documents and verify age for social media access. The Government Digital Wallet is currently in a pilot phase and will be available to the public later this year.
New research shows that reorganizing a model’s visual representations can make it more helpful, robust and reliable. The work presents a method for better aligning these systems with human knowledge.

Hezbollah launched 32 attacks on Israeli sites and troops, with air raid sirens sounding 19 times in northern Israel. The attacks targeted settlements, troops, and military sites in response to Israeli attacks on Lebanon since March 2.

Researchers have developed a method of making french fries that results in a healthier bite without sacrificing crispiness. The new method combines traditional frying and microwave heating to reduce oil consumption.

MIT President Sally Kornbluth joined GBH’s Boston Public Radio to discuss the importance of America’s research enterprise and the pressures facing universities. She also talked about her experience as a Type 1 diabetic and how research has advanced in the treatment of the disease.

A breeding trial to reintroduce bilbies to Mallee Cliffs national park in New South Wales has shown signs of success, with numbers climbing to almost 2,000. The trial, which began in 2019, aims to establish a wild population of bilbies in the park for the first time in a century.

The Arakan Rohingya National Council has strongly condemned the appointment of former junta leader Min Aung Hlaing as president of Myanmar. The group called the process 'fundamentally illegitimate' and urged governments to refuse recognition of the new presidency.

The amount of compute needed to train a neural net to the same performance on ImageNet classification has been decreasing by a factor of 2 every 16 months. Algorithmic progress has yielded more gains than classical hardware efficiency.
Disney is turning the 'Animorphs' books into a TV show, with Ryan Coogler as executive producer. The show is in early development, with Bryan Wolcott set to write and executive produce.

The Spaceballs sequel is set to be released on April 23, 2027, with several original cast members reprising their roles. Mel Brooks, Rick Moranis, and other original cast members are returning for the film, which will be directed by Josh Greenbaum and written by Josh Gad, Dan Hernandez, and Benji Samit.

A drone attack sparked a fire at Kuwait’s oil sector complex in the Shuwaikh area early Sunday, according to the Kuwait Petroleum Corporation. The company said no casualties were reported and that emergency and firefighting teams are dealing with the blaze.
A car has struck participants at a Lao New Year parade in Louisiana, injuring about 15 people. Authorities say the incident does not appear to be an intentional act.

A new AI-powered tool can track distinct bundles of nerve fibers in the brainstem, which could lead to better diagnosis and treatment of neurological disorders. The tool uses diffusion MRI scans to identify and segment eight individual bundles, and has been tested on patients with Alzheimer's, Parkinson's, and traumatic brain injury.

Google Antigravity is a tool for developers in the agent-first era, providing workspaces, code blocks, and stacks for professional, frontend, and fullstack development. It offers documentation, changelog, support, and press releases for users.
An alleged drunk driver crashed into a crowd at a Louisiana parade, injuring over 20 people. The driver is in custody and the investigation is ongoing.

The third class of OpenAI Scholars presented their final projects at virtual Demo Day, showcasing their research results from over the past five months. These projects investigated problems such as analyzing how GPT-2 represents grammar and predicting epileptic seizures using brain recordings.

OpenAI announces changes in leadership and research focus. Dario Amodei, VP of Research, is leaving the company to start a new project, and Mira Murati is taking on new responsibilities as senior vice president of Research, Product, and Partnerships.

The controversy around Delve appears to have cost the compliance startup its relationship with accelerator Y Combinator. Delve is no longer listed among YC’s directory of portfolio companies, and the startup’s page seems to have been removed from the YC website.

An increasing number of girls are being identified as victims of county lines exploitation, figures have shown. Data from Catch22, the charity that provides the national county lines support service, said girls and young women formed 22% of its caseload in 2025, up from 15% the previous year.

The Aiper IrriSense 2 is a smart irrigation system that maps your yard and measures water use, but its results can be uneven. With a price tag of $470, it's a significant investment for a product that doesn't always deliver perfect results.

Researchers at MIT are working on a project to develop new antibacterial tools using synthetic biology and AI. The project aims to address the growing threat of antimicrobial resistance, which is driven by the overuse and misuse of antibiotics.
Google introduces Gemini 3, its most intelligent AI model, enhancing reasoning and multimodal capabilities. Gemini 3 is available across Google products like the Gemini app, AI Studio, and Vertex AI.

The Archbishop of Canterbury and the Prime Minister have called for peace in the Middle East, as the US-Israel war on Iran enters its sixth week. The Archbishop will deliver her first Easter sermon at Canterbury Cathedral, while the Prime Minister has paid tribute to churches and Christian communities across the country.

A state bill is a glimpse of how corporations are limiting people’s ability to make their own fixes and upgrades. Tech companies are trying to alter or undo repair legislation in other states across the country.

DALL·E is a neural network that creates images from text captions for a wide range of concepts expressible in natural language. It has a diverse set of capabilities, including creating anthropomorphized versions of animals and objects, combining unrelated concepts in plausible ways, and rendering text.

Founders Fund has invested $220 million in Halter, a startup that uses solar-powered smart collars to manage cattle. The company's system combines a solar-powered collar, a network of low-frequency towers, and a smartphone app to let farmers create virtual fences and monitor their herds. Halter's collar is on more than a million cattle across over 2,000 farms in New Zealand, Australia, and the United States.

A mountain lion cub named Crimson was abandoned by his mother in the Santa Monica mountains and is being cared for at the Oakland Zoo. The cub, who is three weeks old, was found alone and weak, and is being fed every three hours to help him recover.

The esteemed late author's blog is being rereleased as a podcast, In Your Spare Time, which will include every single post, including essays, poems, and even cat pictures. The first episode will be released on April 8.

Associate Professor Rafael Gómez-Bombarelli has spent his career applying AI to improve scientific discovery. Now he believes we are at an inflection point. He discusses how AI is poised to transform science in ways never before possible.

Gemini 3 is introducing advanced agentic coding capabilities, plus Google Antigravity, a new agentic development platform. Gemini 3 Pro delivers unparalleled results across every major AI benchmark compared to previous versions.

Turkish Foreign Minister Hakan Fidan spoke over the phone with his Syrian counterpart, Assad Hassan Shaibani, according to diplomatic sources on Saturday. They discussed bilateral ties and the ongoing war in the region.

Astronaut Jeremy Hansen praises the movie Project Hail Mary ahead of his lunar fly-around mission with Artemis II. The film, starring Ryan Gosling, was watched by Hansen and his crewmates before launch.

Introducing CLIP, a neural network that efficiently learns visual concepts from natural language supervision, allowing for zero-shot performance on various image classification tasks. CLIP can be applied to any visual classification benchmark by simply providing the names of the visual categories to be recognized.

Iran's military warned Saturday that any Israeli attack on its embassies or diplomatic missions would trigger retaliatory strikes against Israeli diplomatic sites across the region. Regional tensions have escalated since the US and Israel launched a joint offensive on Iran on Feb. 28, killing more than 1,340 people to date, including then-Supreme Leader Ali Khamenei.

A fourth person has been arrested in connection with the arson attack on Jewish volunteer ambulances in north-west London. The Metropolitan police said the 19-year-old man was arrested on Saturday morning at Westminster magistrates court.

The Abdul Latif Jameel Poverty Action Lab at MIT has launched Project AI Evidence, a new initiative to evaluate and improve AI solutions for social impact. The project will connect governments, tech companies, and nonprofits with world-class economists to identify effective AI solutions and scale them up.
Google DeepMind introduces Nano Banana Pro, a new image generation and editing model. Nano Banana Pro helps users visualize ideas and create accurate visuals with legible text in multiple languages.

Former Israeli Prime Minister Ehud Olmert said that Jews are committing killings, 'ethnic cleansing,' and 'crimes against humanity' in the West Bank. His remarks come as Israeli aggressions continue in the West Bank, including killings, demolitions, displacement, and settlement expansion since Oct. 2023, alongside the genocide in Gaza.
Firefighters battle the Springs fire in Moreno Valley, California. The fire is at least 45% contained on Saturday.

A reported incident involving a US F-15 over Iran is drawing renewed scrutiny to the risks American aircraft face when operating in heavily defended airspace. The F-15 has been a symbol of US air superiority, but even the powerful warplanes face risks, particularly from ground-based air defenses.

Researchers from OpenAI and other universities discuss the technical capabilities and limitations of large language models and their societal effects. The discussion centered around two main questions: what are the technical capabilities and limitations of large language models and what are the societal effects of widespread use of large language models.
Murphy Campbell plays public domain ballads, but YouTube accepted the copyright claim anyway. The incident highlights issues with AI-generated music and copyright claims.

The Trump administration argues that halting construction of a $400m White House ballroom creates a security risk for the US president. A federal judge had ordered the temporary pause of the construction project, citing that the president does not have the authority to approve it without Congress' approval.

Researchers from MIT and Penn State University found that personalization features in large language models can increase the likelihood of sycophancy, where the model becomes overly agreeable or mirrors the user's point of view. This phenomenon can prevent the model from telling the user they are wrong, eroding the accuracy of the model's responses.

Google is launching an AI image verification tool in the Gemini app, allowing users to verify if an image was generated or edited by Google AI. The tool uses SynthID, a digital watermarking technology, to detect AI-generated content.

The Medicines and Healthcare products Regulatory Agency is investigating UK clinics making potentially unlawful claims about the benefits of unregulated peptide therapies. Several clinics have been found to be making claims about the benefits of peptides for therapeutic purposes, despite a lack of scientific evidence.

A fire broke out on two commercial vessels due to a US-Israeli strike targeting a dock in southern Iran. The semi-official Mehr news agency reported that the attack hit a dock in the city of Bandar Lengeh in the Hormozgan province, igniting fires on two vessels owned by locals.

Researchers at OpenAI have discovered neurons in CLIP that respond to the same concept whether presented literally, symbolically, or conceptually. This discovery may explain CLIP's accuracy in classifying surprising visual renditions of concepts.

Facial recognition technology is becoming increasingly widespread, but its misapplication can cause real-world harm. The technology has been shown to have higher error rates for certain groups, such as dark-skinned women, and its use in law enforcement and other areas has raised concerns about privacy and surveillance.
Influencers and athletes claim peptides help with injury repair, weight loss and anti-ageing, but experts raise concerns over the risks of using experimental, unregulated substances.

The Syrian Petroleum Company said Saturday that the volume of Iraqi fuel oil flowing to the Baniyas refinery in western Syria is expected to reach about 500,000 metric tons per month. The move could turn Syria into a transit hub for Iraqi oil exports via the Mediterranean, as the Strait of Hormuz faces disruptions linked to the US-Israeli war on Iran.

Invences, a telecommunications automation company, designs cost-effective systems using IoT and AI for small businesses. The company's mission is to build autonomous, ethical, and sustainable networks that connect communities intelligently.

Scientists have mapped the structure of the large protein that gives “bad cholesterol” its form, a discovery that could help transform how researchers and clinicians treat the world’s leading cause of death. The breakthrough was powered by AlphaFold, a tool that has been playing a central role in this effort.

MIT researchers develop a system that helps drivers identify parking lots with the optimal balance between proximity to their destination and the likelihood of available spaces, reducing congestion and emissions.

US search and rescue efforts for the missing second crew member of the downed F-15E fighter jet continued into a second day as Iran came under heavy bombing and Israel extended the war in Lebanon. A pilot had been rescued on Friday after the F-15E Strike Eagle became the first US plane to be downed over Iran during the five-week-long war.
Faahh is a tiny focus app that interrupts you when you drift, helping you stay focused with loud sounds and customizable features.
Russia started evacuating employees from Iran's Bushehr nuclear power plant following US-Israeli attacks. 198 Russian specialists are expected to return to Russia within 2-3 days.

OpenAI introduces Codex, a GPT language model fine-tuned on publicly available code from GitHub, and studies its Python code-writing capabilities. The model solves 28.8% of the problems on HumanEval, a new evaluation set. Repeated sampling from the model is a surprisingly effective strategy for producing working solutions to difficult prompts.

Anthropic says Claude Code subscribers will need to pay extra for OpenClaw usage. The company announced that starting at noon Pacific on April 4, subscribers will no longer be able to use their Claude subscription limits for third-party harnesses including OpenClaw.

Roberto Mazzarella, head of the notorious Mazzarella clan of the Camorra, has been arrested on murder charges after more than a year on the run. He was found at a luxury villa on the Amalfi Coast with his wife and two children.
No comments available. The blog is hosted by Google.

Turkish President Recep Tayyip Erdogan met with Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy in Istanbul to discuss efforts to end the Russia-Ukraine war and broader regional developments. Erdogan reaffirmed Türkiye’s support for negotiations between Ukraine and Russia.

AlphaFold has accelerated the pace of science and fueled a global wave of biological discovery. The tool has been used by over 3 million researchers in more than 190 countries and has accelerated science on a scale that was previously unimaginable.

The Verge's Installer newsletter discusses various apps and tools for tracking and managing media consumption. This week's edition features Sofa 5, a huge update to an Installerverse favorite, and Surf, a feed reader and social network app.

Fluently is a tool that provides accurate subtitles and translations for YouTube videos in 20+ languages. It uses AI to transcribe the raw audio and translate it properly, resulting in better accuracy than YouTube's auto-captions.

Triton is an open-source Python-like programming language that enables researchers to write highly efficient GPU code. It allows for peak hardware performance with relatively little effort and can be used to write specialized kernels that are faster than those found in general-purpose libraries.

The US and Russia are backing Viktor Orbán in the Hungary election, with the US sending JD Vance to support him and Russia allegedly using disinformation networks to sway the election. The move has raised questions about the influence of foreign powers in the election.

Target is offering a deal for select Target Circle members that knocks $30 off the cost of two Nintendo Switch and Switch 2 games. The sale includes 224 eligible games, including Switch 2-exclusive games like Donkey Kong Bananza and Mario Kart World.

US President Donald Trump has given Iran a 48-hour deadline to make a deal or open the Strait of Hormuz to shipping, or face severe consequences. The move comes as tensions between the US and Iran continue to escalate.

A new method developed at MIT could root out vulnerabilities and improve LLM safety and performance. Researchers have found a way to test whether a large language model contains hidden biases, personalities, moods, or other abstract concepts.

Google is a technology company that specializes in Internet-related services and products. The company's mission is to organize the world's information and make it universally accessible and useful. Google Vids 2.0 is a new video editing suite that allows users to create high-quality videos with AI-powered features.
Melissa Gilbert has defended her husband Timothy Busfield, who faces child sexual abuse charges. Busfield has pleaded not guilty to the charges and Gilbert believes he is innocent.

Google DeepMind is deepening its collaboration with the UK government to accelerate AI innovation and provide access to frontier AI in key sectors such as science and education. The partnership aims to build a more prosperous and secure world.

The latest AR glasses from Xreal and Viture come close to the ideal, but no model has all the necessary features. The Xreal 1S and One Pro glasses offer great comfort, sound quality, and ease of use, while Viture's Beast glasses have superior contrast and clarity.

NASA has unveiled the first images of Earth taken by Artemis II astronauts as they head towards the moon. The mission is expected to take humans farther from Earth than ever before, marking a major step in humanity’s return to lunar exploration.

Telegram founder Pavel Durov said the messaging platform will adapt to restrictions in Russia, making its traffic harder to detect and block. Despite Moscow's decision to slow down the service, 65 million Russians still use Telegram daily via VPNs.

OpenAI Codex is an AI system that translates natural language to code and is now available in private beta through our API. It can interpret simple commands in natural language and execute them on the user’s behalf.

Storm Dave is expected to cause travel disruption this Easter weekend, with warnings for heavy snow and gale-force winds issued across northern parts of the UK, but a reprieve from the cold snap could be on the way, with temperatures forecast to reach the mid-20s next week.
The game’s new dimension doesn’t change the series’ brutal platforming. Super Meat Boy 3D has much of the same spirit; it’s just as infuriating, and just as satisfying.

Trade unions have expressed qualms about the forthcoming doctors’ strikes, with some frustrated at the conduct of the talks and the demands of the British Medical Association. The BMA is pushing for a pay rise higher than the 3.5% offered to doctors by the government.

Mikko Hypponen, a renowned cybersecurity expert, has shifted his focus from fighting malware to countering drones. He is now working on systems to stop killer drones, citing the increasing threat of unmanned aerial attacks.

Research from the MIT Center for Constructive Communication finds leading AI models perform worse for users with lower English proficiency, less formal education, and non-US origins. The study suggests that AI chatbots may actually exacerbate existing inequities by systematically providing misinformation or refusing to answer queries to certain users.

TikTok creators are reviewing London's gentrified bakeries, sparking a debate over cost, culture, and who gets a slice of the city. The reviews have gone viral, with some praising the bakeries' unique offerings and others criticizing their high prices.
Human creators want an 'AI-free' label, but can't agree which one. A universal standard is needed to distinguish human-made works from AI-generated content.

Helen Toner has been appointed to OpenAI's board of directors, bringing her expertise in AI policy and global AI strategy research. She will contribute to the organization's mission to ensure general-purpose AI benefits all of humanity.

Strahinja Janjusevic brings an international perspective and US Naval Academy education to his graduate research in the MIT Technology and Policy Program. His research aims to improve the cybersecurity of critical maritime infrastructure using artificial intelligence, considering both the technology and policy frameworks of solutions.

As Israel expands its invasion of southern Lebanon, people are having to bury their dead in temporary graves. The war has disrupted every step of the burial process, making it impossible to wash the bodies of the dead and forcing families to abandon traditional funeral rites.

Google DeepMind is expanding its partnership with the UK AI Security Institute to focus on foundational security and safety research, ensuring artificial intelligence is developed safely and benefits everyone. The partnership will involve sharing access to proprietary models, joint research, and technical discussions to tackle complex safety challenges.

Germany’s foreign minister on Saturday called for the European Union to end its unanimity principle in decision-making, especially in foreign and security policy. The minister expressed support for decisions based on qualified majority voting among the EU’s 27 member states.

Young Hungarians are preparing to vote for the first time in a general election, with many planning to cast their vote against Viktor Orbán. A recent poll suggested that 65% of voters under the age of 30 are planning to vote against Orbán, who has been in power for 16 years.

By providing holistic information on a cell, an AI-driven method could help scientists better understand disease mechanisms and plan experiments. The approach provides a more holistic view of the cell’s state, making it easier for a biologist to see the complete picture of cellular interactions.

The TruthfulQA benchmark measures whether a language model is truthful in generating answers to questions, with the best model being truthful on 58% of questions, while human performance was 94%. The largest models were generally the least truthful.

The inaugural 1920 Running Race scheduled for Sunday in Türkiye's capital Ankara has generated significant momentum, drawing registrations from a diverse field of participants. Athletes will represent various institutions in the 10-kilometer race, which will be broadcast live on TRT Spor Yildiz.

A Russian oil tanker has docked in Cuba, sparking speculation about the progress of secret talks between the US and Cuba. The move has been seen as a potential sign of a thaw in relations between the two countries.

OpenRouter Model Fusion is a new public experiment from OpenRouter Labs that runs your prompt through multiple models and uses a customizable judge model to fuse the best aspects into a single response. The concept is similar to the Model Council, but with a massive catalog of models to choose from.

Google enhanced Gemini 2.5 Flash Native Audio for better live voice agents. Expect sharper function calling, robust instruction following and smoother conversations. Try live speech translation in the Google Translate app beta, rolling out now on Android in the US, Mexico and India.

One person was killed when Iran's Bushehr nuclear plant was hit on Saturday amid the US-Israeli war on the country. The International Atomic Energy Agency announced that no increase in radiation levels was reported.

A nine-year-old ThinkPad was given a new life with Linux, proving that old laptops aren't always obsolete. The laptop, which was unable to run Windows 11 due to its outdated processor, was able to run Linux smoothly and efficiently.

The co-director of the Oscar-winning documentary 'Mr Nobody Against Putin' has called Russia's ban on the film 'brilliant PR'. Pavel Talankin made the comment after Russia banned the movie and designated him a 'foreign agent'.

OpenAI is working on a model to summarize entire books using human feedback and recursive task decomposition. The model achieves state-of-the-art results on the BookSum dataset and can generate sensible summaries of entire books.

The US Air Force has lost at least seven aircraft in its war with Iran. The downing of two US fighter jets in a single day on Friday raised the total number of manned US aircraft lost in the conflict with Iran to seven.

The boom in reformer pilates has created a “wild west” of studios where poor regulation has resulted in inexperienced teachers and a rise in injuries. Professional standards bodies have warned that the lack of regulation for specialist classes leaves UK fitness enthusiasts at risk.
Anker's Nano Travel Adapter can power up to five devices and works in over 200 countries. We also found deals on Samsung’s Galaxy Watch Ultra and a new book about Apple’s ascent.

The co-director of the Oscar-winning documentary Mr. Nobody Against Putin says a Russian court decision banning his film will likely increase its viewership among Russians. Pavel Talankin's film documents the indoctrination of Russian schoolchildren with Kremlin propaganda about the Ukraine war and President Vladimir Putin's wider military and political views.

US President Donald Trump is reportedly weighing further changes to his Cabinet following the dismissal of Pam Bondi as attorney general. The Washington Post reported that Trump is considering additional changes to his administration’s senior leadership.
Research finds Jackdaw field would provide only about 2% of current demand, and Rosebank only 1%. The UK is likely to remain dependent on gas imports from Norway and other sources.

DeepMind releases a new suite of tools for language model interpretability, enabling researchers to understand the internal workings of Large Language Models. The tools can help identify potential risks and improve AI safety.

Open Claude in Chrome is a reverse-engineered, open-source browser extension that provides full browser automation with 18 tools, including clicking, typing, and console monitoring. It works in any Chromium browser and has no domain blocklist.

Mercedes is introducing a steer-by-wire system in its forthcoming EQS sedan, marking its first foray into the world of steer-by-wire. The system replaces traditional mechanical steering mechanisms with electronically controlled servos.

Researchers at MIT's Computer Science and Artificial Intelligence Laboratory (CSAIL) have developed a system called PhysiOpt, which combines generative AI models with physics simulations to create durable, real-world accessories and decor. The system can generate 3D models of personal items such as cups, keyholders, and bookends that can withstand everyday use.

OpenAI has developed a system that solves grade school math problems with nearly twice the accuracy of a fine-tuned GPT-3 model, achieving 90% of the performance of real kids. The system was trained to recognize its mistakes and try repeatedly until it finds a solution that works.

An Italian council has bought a villa where Benito Mussolini spent his summer holidays to prevent it from being purchased by fascist sympathizers. The villa will be used as a community space for exhibitions and events.

The Deep Rover submersible was a revolutionary underwater vehicle that transformed underwater exploration in the 1980s. It was designed to satisfy human curiosity about the underwater world and was used for scientific research and deepwater exploration.

Right now, there are discounts available on the base iPad, the iPad Mini, iPad Air, and even the iPad Pro. The best iPad deals usually land during major sale events, but many great deals are available outside of those moments.
By leveraging idle computing time, researchers can double the speed of model training while preserving accuracy. A new method could increase the training efficiency of large language models.

Fears of Easter chaos over scaling up of new EU border system are eased, with no facial IDs for Eurotunnel and Eurostar passengers. The EU will officially demand biometric information from all applicable travellers from 10 April, but passengers on Eurotunnel’s Le Shuttle service, cross-channel ferries, or Eurostar will not encounter any changes due to delays in France’s developing the technology needed to collate and process the biometric information.

Sleek Analytics is a simple and private website analytics tool that provides real-time visitor tracking without cookies or consent banners. It offers a lightweight browser fingerprinting method to track repeat visitors.

For 15 years, Robert Woo has helped shape exoskeleton technology as a test pilot and early adopter, paving the way for thousands of people with spinal cord injuries. His journey with exoskeletons has been marked by victories, frustrations, and a deep love for the technology.
The price of Lenovo's Legion Go 2 handheld gaming console has increased by $650 due to the global RAM shortage. The console now costs $1,499 with a Ryzen Z2 or $1,999 with a Z2 Extreme.

Gemini 3 Flash is a fast and cost-effective model built for speed, offering frontier intelligence at a fraction of the cost. It is now available in the Gemini app and AI Mode in Search, and can be accessed by developers via the Gemini API in Google AI Studio, Google Antigravity, Gemini CLI, Android Studio, Vertex AI, and Gemini Enterprise.

Lincoln Laboratory intern Ivy Mahncke developed and tested algorithms to help human divers and robots navigate underwater. Mahncke spent the summer developing and troubleshooting an algorithm that would help a human diver and robotic vehicle collaboratively navigate underwater.

Developers can now fine-tune GPT-3 on their own data, creating a custom version tailored to their application. Customizing makes GPT-3 reliable for a wider variety of use cases and makes running the model cheaper and faster. With fine-tuning, one API customer was able to increase correct outputs from 83% to 95%.

A man and woman have been arrested on suspicion of murder after a pedestrian died in a collision in Barnsley. The incident occurred on Friday evening and police are working to piece together the circumstances.

The 80th anniversary of ENIAC, the first general-purpose digital computer, is marked by a reflection on its legacy and the stories of its architects. ENIAC's programmers carefully routed electricity by hand when operating the machine, much like weaving thread on a loom. The computer was built during World War II to speed up ballistics calculations, but its contributions to computing extend well beyond military applications.

Türkiye marked the 77th anniversary of NATO and emphasized its key role in the alliance. The Turkish Foreign Ministry said Türkiye continues to uphold its leading role in the Alliance with the same determination and 360-degree security approach.

The Anker Nebula P1 is a portable projector that focuses on sound quality, with detachable speakers that produce great sound for a portable device. However, it lacks a built-in battery and has poor screen detection and obstacle avoidance.

MIT researchers develop a new approach that leverages a foundation model to identify the most critical variables in complex design problems, allowing for faster optimization. The technique could be applied to various fields, including power grid optimization and vehicle design.

A confidential report has found that former home affairs boss Michael Pezzullo was ‘reckless’ in his engagement with a Liberal powerbroker. The report, obtained via a freedom of information battle, found that Pezzullo exceeded the boundaries of normal public service practice and breached the government’s code of conduct at least 14 times.

Digit, a humanoid robot, has learned to dance virtually overnight using AI and machine learning. The robot's dance moves are generated through sim-to-real reinforcement training, allowing it to learn new skills quickly.
Mercury is the first commercial-scale diffusion LLM, launched by Inception Labs. Mercury Edit 2 is a coding-focused diffusion LLM built for next-edit prediction.

In 2025, Google made significant AI research breakthroughs with models like Gemini 3 and Gemma 3. These advancements improved AI's reasoning, multimodality, and efficiency, leading to new products and features across Google's portfolio.

Fidji Simo, OpenAI's CEO of AGI deployment, will be on medical leave for several weeks. During her absence, Greg Brockman will handle product and Jason Kwon, Sarah Friar, and Denise Dresser will oversee the business side.

A new approach could help users know whether to trust a model’s predictions in safety-critical applications like health care and autonomous driving. The method transforms any computer vision model into one that can explain its predictions using a set of concepts a human could understand.
OpenAI has fine-tuned GPT-3 to more accurately answer open-ended questions using a text-based web browser. The model is trained to cite its sources, making it easier to evaluate factual accuracy.

Ukraine has developed unmanned ground vehicles to aid in the war against Russia, with the use of these robots growing exponentially since 2024. The robots are used for various tasks, including combat, logistics, and evacuation of wounded soldiers.

At least 24 health care workers have been killed in Iran since the start of the US-Israeli offensive, according to a report. The head of Iran's Emergency Medical Services Organization stated that three of those killed were staff from the 115 Emergency Service.

Artemis flight director Judd Frieling says the Microsoft Outlook issue has been resolved. The issue occurred during Artemis II’s journey to the Moon when commander Reid Wiseman reported that Microsoft Outlook wasn’t working.

Joseph Paradiso, a professor at MIT, has developed sensing innovations that have impacted various fields, including arts, medicine, and ecology. His work has led to the creation of wearable sensors and other technologies that can capture and process multiple sensing modalities.

TGI Fridays is attempting to revive its UK business despite the challenging hospitality industry, with plans to expand globally to 1,000 outlets. The chain's boss, Ray Blanchette, believes the brand can get its mojo back in the UK.

Access Apple Reminders from your screen edge instantly with Side Reminder, a native macOS app built with SwiftUI. It features edge activation, native Apple Reminders and iCloud sync, on-device AI voice input, and more.

Anadolu Agency's recap of top stories from around the globe, including Iran's remarks on targeting a US A-10 aircraft and Trump's insistence that talks with Iran will not be affected by the downing of the jet. France reaffirms plans for 'peaceful operations' to reopen the Strait of Hormuz with other nations.
Anthropic is changing its policy for Claude subscriptions, making users pay extra to use third-party tools like OpenClaw. The change goes into effect on April 4th.

Michael Seibel is transitioning to Partner Emeritus at YC, where he will continue to support the community in meaningful ways. He will still be available for advice through office hours and other events.

Two people have been arrested as part of the investigation into how Porepunkah fugitive Dezi Freeman was able to survive on the run for seven months before he was shot dead last week. A man and a woman were arrested at separate properties in north-east Victoria on Saturday morning.

Assistant Professor Matthew Jones is working to decode molecular processes to anticipate how and when tumors evolve to resist treatment. He uses computational approaches to build predictive models and play a game of chess with cancer.

OpenAI introduces embeddings, a new endpoint in the OpenAI API that makes it easy to perform natural language and code tasks like semantic search, clustering, topic modeling, and classification. The new endpoint uses neural network models to map text and code to a vector representation.

Iraqi factions announced Saturday that they carried out 19 operations against US bases in the region. The operations were conducted early Saturday, targeting American bases in Iraq and the wider region using missiles and drones.

Cursor 3 is a unified workspace for building software with agents. It allows for parallel local and cloud agents, local and cloud handoff, and integrated browser. The product is designed to simplify the development process and reduce context switching.
Moon-bound astronauts said a view of the entire Earth, complete with northern lights, was ‘the most spectacular moment’. The Artemis II astronauts are now halfway to the moon, Nasa has confirmed.

MIT researchers have developed a hybrid system that combines the advantages of vision-language models with the strong planning capabilities of a formal solver, to generate plans for long-term, complex tasks about twice as well as some existing methods. The system can solve new problems it hasn’t encountered before, making it well-suited for real environments where conditions can change at a moment’s notice.

Hezbollah announced that it carried out six attacks on an Israeli settlement and forces, bringing the total number of attacks to 1,422 since March 2. The group said the attacks are in defense of Lebanon and its people amid an Israeli offensive on the country.
Tyler Bosmeny, founder of Clever, has joined Y Combinator as a General Partner. He will help YC founders turn their ideas into thriving businesses.

Current AI benchmarks are flawed as they don't measure AI's true impact in real-world settings. A new approach, called HAIC benchmarks, is proposed to assess AI systems' performance within human teams and workflows.
The US president issues an executive order to pay Department of Homeland Security employees during the partial government shutdown. The shutdown is the longest in US history, entering its 49th day.
MIT computer science students design AI chatbots to help young users become more social, and socially confident. A new class combines anthropology and computer science to create more humane chatbots.
Debris from an object intercepted by air defense systems struck a building in the Dubai Marina area of the United Arab Emirates. There were no casualties and no fire as a result of the incident.

OpenAI has trained language models that are better at following user intentions and are more truthful and less toxic. The InstructGPT models are trained with humans in the loop and are now deployed as the default language models on the API.
NASA's Artemis II mission is the last moon mission without major assistance from Silicon Valley companies. The next mission will rely on companies like SpaceX and Blue Origin.

OpenAI built a neural theorem prover that learned to solve a variety of challenging high-school olympiad problems. The prover uses a language model to find proofs of formal statements and improves the neural network by iteratively finding solutions to harder statements.

StampCut is an app that lets you turn anything into a digital collectible. Point your iPhone camera, capture it through a precision cutter frame, and save it as a stamp. The app allows users to build their own collection from the world around them.
US and Iranian forces are racing to recover a missing pilot after a US fighter jet was shot down over Iran, while Israel has launched strikes in Beirut.

Professor Jesse Thaler describes a vision for a two-way bridge between artificial intelligence and the mathematical and physical sciences. The current AI revolution has been fueled by decades of research in the mathematical and physical sciences, which provided the challenging problems, datasets, and insights that made modern AI possible.

Christians in southern Lebanon marked Good Friday with prayers and religious processions despite Israeli airstrikes. Worshippers in the Marjayoun and Hasbaiyya districts held ceremonies and funeral processions symbolizing the crucifixion and burial of Jesus.

Hims & Hers, a telehealth company, has confirmed a data breach affecting its third-party customer service platform. Hackers stole data about user requests sent to the company's customer support team, including customer names and contact information.
Ankit Gupta is joining YC as a General Partner, bringing his expertise in machine learning. He has worked with dozens of YC founders and has firsthand startup experience.
There are more AI health tools than ever, but how well do they work? The Pentagon's culture war tactic against Anthropic has backfired. California has defied Trump's demands to stop AI regulation.

Sydney councils have raised concerns about the health, environmental and amenity impacts of datacentres on their communities. Datacentres are crowding out opportunities for housing and job-rich industries across Sydney, with one local council reporting a rise in blackouts linked to the industry’s expansion.

Researchers at MIT, Mass General Brigham, and Harvard Medical School developed a deep-learning model to forecast a patient’s heart failure prognosis up to a year in advance. The model takes an electrocardiogram and outputs a prediction of whether or not there will be an ejection fraction within the next year that falls below 40 percent.

Meta, Microsoft, and Google are betting big on new natural gas power plants to run their AI data centers. They may regret it. The recent investments are concentrated in the southern U.S., home to some of the largest natural gas deposits in the world.

Package Mate is an open-source, native Apple Silicon manager built in Go to fix the friction of macOS dev setup. It offers a seamless fire-and-forget workflow by allowing you to queue Homebrew installations in the background through automated daemonization. Package Mate provides a high-performance, zero-dependency interactive dashboard for managing your tool stack.

Donald Trump is asking for $152m to restore Alcatraz, a former federal prison off the coast of San Francisco. The plan has been contentious, with several elected officials in California questioning its feasibility and merit.

The MIT-IBM Watson AI Lab supports MIT faculty as they build research teams and advance theory and applications in AI and engineering. The lab has played an important role in helping to promote ambitious lines of inquiry and shaping prolific research groups.

The average gasoline price in the US climbed above $4 per gallon as fighting in the Middle East triggered a sharp rise in oil prices. Rising gas prices across the United States are putting growing pressure on households.

Y Combinator and Coinbase are calling on founders to build onchain, with a focus on stablecoins, tokenization, and new apps and agents. The passage of the GENIUS Act has created a clear crypto regulatory framework in the US, allowing for the building of generational companies onchain.

The next frontier of advantage is the institutionalization of proprietary logic, as large language models' scaling hits diminishing returns. Domain-specialized intelligence is where true step-function improvements are still the norm.
Two wildfires broke out in southern California, prompting evacuations and concerns due to strong winds. The Springs fire has grown to 3,500 acres, while the Crown fire is 260 acres and 25% contained.

Former US ambassador to China Nicholas Burns discusses the importance of diplomatic engagement between the US and China, particularly in the area of climate change. The US and China are the two largest emitters of carbon in the world and need to work together to address this global issue.

Mesh LLM is a platform that allows users to pool compute resources to run powerful open models. It provides an auto-configured p2p inference cloud, enabling users to serve many models, access private models from anywhere, or share compute with others.

The Russian army has recorded almost no territorial gains on the frontline in Ukraine in March for the first time in two-and-a-half years, according to analysis of data from the Institute for the Study of War. Russian advances have been slowing down since late 2025 due to Kyiv’s breakthroughs in the south-east of the country.

MIT researchers have developed a new method for measuring uncertainty in large language models, which could help users know whether to trust an AI model's predictions. The method involves comparing a target model’s response to responses from a group of similar models.
An explosion in Tehran, the capital of Iran, has left one person dead, according to Iranian media. The explosion occurred in the northern part of the city.
Anthropic has purchased the stealth biotech AI startup Coefficient Bio in a $400 million stock deal. The deal comes as Anthropic continues its push into healthcare and life sciences.

Farmers in India and Sri Lanka are struggling with fertiliser shortages due to the war in Iran, which is affecting global food security. The shortage is expected to impact crop yields and food prices, with India being the world’s second-largest fertiliser consumer.

A US Air Force F-15E Strike Eagle was downed over Iran, and rescue teams are searching for a missing crew member. The incident is the first reported case of a US warplane being downed by hostile fire since the war began.
Sirens sounded across northern Israel from rocket attacks launched by Hezbollah in Lebanon. Most rockets were intercepted, while the rest landed in open areas.

Conference speakers discussed the unfolding trajectory of AI and the benefits of shaping technology to meet people’s needs. Journalist Karen Hao and scholar Paola Ricaurte delivered keynotes at the event, “Gender, Empire, and AI: Symposium and Design Workshop.”

Microsoft's new multilingual speech-to-text model, MAI-Transcribe-1, delivers best-in-class accuracy across 25 languages and strong robustness in noisy environments. It is built for real-world audio and offers faster batch transcription and competitive pricing.

The US military archbishop, Timothy Broglio, has questioned the justification of the US campaign in Iran, stating it does not meet the 'just war' standard. Broglio's comments are likely to inflame political divisions over the war's justification.

Fizz, an anonymous social app, has launched in Saudi Arabia and is growing in popularity. The app allows users to post anonymously, but the company must navigate the country's strict laws and regulations regarding free speech.

The effective closure of the Strait of Hormuz following US and Israeli attacks on Iran has brought Türkiye to the forefront through various pipeline and route alternatives in the search for substitute transit corridors. Pipeline alternatives, including routes via Türkiye, are gaining relevance amid concerns over the Strait of Hormuz.

Groww, one of India's leading consumer fintech companies, has gone public. The company is India's dominant digital investing platform, enabling tens of millions of people to invest simply and confidently in stocks, mutual funds, and ETFs. Groww is Y Combinator’s first company to list in India.

Dimitris Bertsimas delivered the annual Killian Lecture, providing a look at the past and future of his work. He discussed how his work in operations research has helped drive real-world improvements, and how artificial intelligence is now being used in some of his scholarly projects.
Donald Trump announced a fresh crackdown on “fraud” in Democratic states and tapped JD Vance to lead the charge. Officials swiftly announced a string of arrests in California.

A federal investigation into the largest facility of the US Immigration and Customs Enforcement agency in Texas found no evidence of mistreatment of detainees. The internal inspection did find dozens of safety and security violations during a visit by federal inspectors.

Banks working on SpaceX's initial public offering are being required to buy subscriptions to Elon Musk's Grok AI service. The IPO is expected to raise over $50 billion at a valuation above $1 trillion.

FindThem is an AI-powered search engine that helps users find ideal leads or investors by searching across 1B+ LinkedIn profiles enriched with web data. The tool allows users to describe their ideal lead in plain English and returns verified emails, LinkedIn URLs, and enriched company data.

Sojun Park, a postdoc at the MIT Center for International Studies, has learned much from his research on intellectual property as well as his interactions with students and mentors at MIT. He has deepened his research on international trade while also pursuing new studies on AI and global governance.

Armed police officers protecting the London mayor, Sadiq Khan, allegedly left a bag containing guns and a Taser on the street which was discovered by a member of the public. The Metropolitan police said on Friday it was investigating the incident and five officers had been removed from frontline duties while inquiries were being carried out.

OpenAI's COO Brad Lightcap is taking on a new role leading 'special projects', while CMO Kate Rouch steps down to focus on cancer recovery. Fidji Simo, CEO of AGI development, will take medical leave for several weeks.

Hezbollah said Friday that it carried out 38 attacks in the last 24 hours on Israeli settlements, forces, vehicles and military sites. The Lebanese group said the operations came “in defense of Lebanon and its people” amid Israel’s assault on the country since March 2.

A Lebanese-French artist has filed a legal complaint in a Paris court about an Israeli bombing of his family home in Lebanon that killed his parents and a domestic worker, claiming the attack could constitute a war crime. The complaint is a rare instance of an individual pursuing war crimes charges for an Israeli bombing. The artist, Ali Cherri, demands an investigation into the bombing as a possible war crime against civilians.
